# PhotoEdit English UI strings: 繁體原文<TAB>English. \n = newline, \\ = backslash. Generated by i18n_merge.py.

節點	Node

縮放	Zoom
吸管	Eyedropper
橡皮擦	Eraser
形狀建立	Shape Builder
刀具	Knife
智慧填色	Smart Fill
陰影	Shadow
透明度	Transparency
封套	Envelope

共用	Common
點陣	Raster
向量	Vector
色彩	Color
最近	Recent
先開啟一張照片。	Open a photo first.
先按「＋ 漸層濾鏡」或「＋ 局部筆刷」，或從清單選一個局部調整。	Click "+ Graduated Filter" or "+ Local Brush" first, or pick a local adjustment from the list.
先在照片上點選一段文字或一張貼圖。	Click a text or sticker on the photo first.
先在照片上點選一段文字，或按「＋ 文字」。	Click a text on the photo first, or click "+ Text".
先按「自動去背」。	Click "Auto Remove Background" first.
在右邊的數值上按兩下歸零。	Double-click the value on the right to reset it.
調整	Adjust
光線與色彩：曝光、對比、亮部、暗部、色溫、飽和度與銳利度，也有一鍵自動增強。	Light and color: exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, temperature, saturation and sharpness, plus one-click auto enhance.
效果	Effects
暗角、褪色、顆粒，以及把整張照片染成單一色調的色彩濾鏡。	Vignette, fade, grain, and color filters that tint the whole photo in one hue.
下方濾鏡列可以一次套用整組風格。	The filter strip below applies a whole look at once.
人像	Portrait
美顏（肌膚、五官、一鍵美顏、個別臉）、液化筆刷與智慧構圖；開啟照片後會自動偵測人臉。	Beauty (skin, features, one-click beauty, per face), liquify brush and smart composition; faces are detected automatically when a photo opens.
修補	Retouch
移除污點與雜物、降噪、透視校正、拉直與裁切。	Remove blemishes and objects, reduce noise, fix perspective, straighten and crop.
修補筆刷的快捷鍵是 H。	The shortcut for the healing brush is H.
局部	Local
只調整照片的一部分（漸層濾鏡、局部筆刷），以及背景模糊、移軸特效。	Adjust only part of the photo (graduated filter, local brush), plus background blur and tilt-shift.
裝飾	Decorate
幫照片加上邊框：白邊、黑邊、拍立得、圓角、底片。	Add a frame: white border, black border, Polaroid, rounded corners, film.
貼圖	Stickers
把貼圖拖到照片上；可以切換主題，貼上後能移動、縮放、旋轉。	Drag stickers onto the photo; switch themes, then move, resize and rotate them.
貼圖放在程式資料夾的 stick\\主題\\ 裡。	Stickers are kept in the stick\\theme\\ folder inside the program folder.
文字	Text
加入文字：字型、15 種樣式，以及外框、底色、陰影、發光、立體、填色等特效。	Add text: fonts, 15 styles, and effects such as outline, background, shadow, glow, 3D and fill.
去背	Cutout
用 AI 自動找出主體，背景可以換成透明、純色、模糊或其他圖片，也能把主體存成貼圖。	AI finds the subject automatically; replace the background with transparency, a solid color, blur or another picture, or save the subject as a sticker.
面板寬度	Panel width
拖曳這條分隔線，調整照片與右側工作面板的比例。	Drag this divider to change the size of the photo and the work panel on the right.
寬度會記住，下次開啟時沿用。	The width is remembered for next time.
直方圖	Histogram
照片亮度的分布：左邊是暗部、右邊是亮部；紅、綠、藍三色分開顯示。	How the brightness is spread: shadows on the left, highlights on the right; red, green and blue shown separately.
整座山擠在一邊表示偏暗或偏亮；碰到左右邊緣表示有細節變成全黑或全白。	A hill crowded to one side means the photo is dark or bright; touching the edges means some detail became pure black or white.
重設調整	Reset adjustments
清除色調、效果、細節、降噪、人像與局部調整。	Clear tone, effects, detail, noise reduction, portrait and local adjustments.
裁切、透視、污點修補、文字與貼圖會保留；想全部清掉請用「檔案 → 回復原圖」。	Crop, perspective, spot healing, text and stickers are kept; to clear everything use "File → Revert to Original".
按住看原圖	Hold to compare
按住滑鼠時顯示還沒編輯的原圖，放開就回到編輯後的樣子。	While you hold the mouse button the unedited original is shown; release to see your edits again.
用來比較調整前後的差別。	Use it to compare before and after.
裁切比例	Crop ratio
固定裁切框的長寬比：1:1、4:3、16:9、IG 的 4:5 與 1.91:1、A4、證件照 3.5×4.5 cm…；「自由」可以任意拉。	Lock the aspect ratio of the crop box: 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, Instagram 4:5 and 1.91:1, A4, ID photo 3.5×4.5 cm…; "Free" lets you drag freely.
選比例時會依偵測到的臉自動構圖；按「⇄ 直橫」切換直式或橫式。	Picking a ratio frames detected faces automatically; click "⇄ Rotate" to switch portrait or landscape.
直橫互換	Swap orientation
把比例換成直式或橫式（例如 4:3 ↔ 3:4）；自由比例時把目前的框轉 90 度。	Switch the ratio between portrait and landscape (e.g. 4:3 ↔ 3:4); with a free ratio the current box turns 90 degrees.
輔助線	Guides
裁切框裡的參考線：三分線、黃金比例、格線（6×6）、對角線，或不顯示。	Guide lines in the crop box: rule of thirds, golden ratio, grid (6×6), diagonals, or none.
把主體放在線的交點上，構圖比較好看。	Place the subject on an intersection for a nicer composition.
裁切形狀	Crop shape
裁成圓形、圓角、愛心或星形：形狀外變透明。	Crop to a circle, rounded rectangle, heart or star: outside the shape becomes transparent.
匯出時存成 PNG 才會保留透明；搭配 1:1 比例就是正圓。	Transparency is kept only when you export as PNG; with a 1:1 ratio you get a perfect circle.
精確尺寸	Exact size
直接輸入裁切後的寬與高（原圖像素），以目前框的中心為準。	Type the width and height after cropping (original pixels), centered on the current box.
固定比例時只要輸入一邊；拖曳裁切框時這裡也會跟著更新。	With a fixed ratio you only need one side; this updates as you drag the crop box.
拉直	Straighten
邊裁切邊轉正照片，每格 0.5°；四周自動裁掉，不會出現空白。	Level the photo while cropping, 0.5° per step; the edges are trimmed so no blank corners appear.
數值上按兩下歸零。	Double-click the value to reset it.
向左轉	Rotate left
照片逆時針轉 90 度，裁切框重新置中。	Rotate the photo 90° counterclockwise and re-center the crop box.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+L。	Shortcut Ctrl+L.
向右轉	Rotate right
照片順時針轉 90 度，裁切框重新置中。	Rotate the photo 90° clockwise and re-center the crop box.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+R。	Shortcut Ctrl+R.
水平翻轉	Flip horizontal
左右鏡射照片，裁切框跟著鏡射。	Mirror the photo left to right; the crop box is mirrored too.
垂直翻轉	Flip vertical
上下翻轉照片，裁切框跟著翻轉。	Flip the photo upside down; the crop box flips too.
智慧構圖	Smart composition
依人臉自動擺好裁切框：臉群水平置中、眼睛落在上方三分線。	Place the crop box around faces automatically: faces centered horizontally, eyes on the upper third line.
沒有偵測到臉時以畫面中央為準。	Without detected faces the center of the picture is used.
套用裁切	Apply crop
只保留框內的範圍。	Keep only what is inside the box.
快捷鍵 Enter；之後還可以再按 Ctrl+K 重新調整。	Shortcut Enter; press Ctrl+K later to adjust again.
取消裁切	Cancel crop
放棄這次的裁切，連同裁切時做的拉直、旋轉、翻轉一起還原。	Discard this crop together with the straightening, rotation and flips done while cropping.
快捷鍵 Esc。	Shortcut Esc.
濾	F
原色	Original
清除所有色調與效果，回到照片本來的顏色。	Clear all tone and effects and return to the photo's own colors.
濾鏡只換色調與效果，不動裁切、銳利度與人像。	Filters change only tone and effects; crop, sharpness and portrait edits are untouched.
鮮豔	Vivid
提高對比與飽和度，顏色更飽滿，適合風景與美食。	More contrast and saturation for richer colors; great for landscapes and food.
日系清新	Japanese fresh
明亮、低對比、略偏青藍，空氣感的日系風格。	Bright, low contrast, slightly cyan-blue: an airy Japanese look.
暖陽	Warm sun
偏暖的色溫加上淡淡暗角，像傍晚的陽光。	A warmer temperature with a light vignette, like evening sunlight.
冷調	Cool
偏藍的冷色調，適合城市、雪景與海邊。	A cool bluish tone for cities, snow and the seaside.
懷舊	Nostalgic
降低飽和、褪色並偏暖，像放了很久的彩色照片。	Less saturation, faded and warmer, like an old color print.
老照片	Old photo
褐色單色加上暗角與顆粒，像早年的相片。	Sepia monochrome with vignette and grain, like a photo from long ago.
黑白	Black & white
轉成黑白並稍微加強對比。	Convert to black and white with a little more contrast.
高反差黑白	High-contrast B&W
強烈對比的黑白，加上暗角與顆粒，適合街拍。	Strong black and white contrast with vignette and grain; great for street photos.
底片	Film
柔和的亮部、微暖的色調與顆粒，模仿底片相機。	Soft highlights, a slightly warm tone and grain, like a film camera.
電影感	Cinematic
壓低亮部與飽和、暗部偏青、亮部偏橘，像電影畫面。	Lower highlights and saturation, teal shadows and orange highlights, like a movie frame.
夢幻	Dreamy
明亮、低對比、略帶粉紫，柔和夢幻的感覺。	Bright, low contrast with a hint of pink and purple: soft and dreamy.
水彩畫	Watercolor
把照片畫成水彩：色塊簡化、顏色微微暈開、色塊邊緣有水痕，帶紙紋與顆粒的透明感。	Paint the photo as a watercolor: simplified color areas, colors bleeding slightly, water marks along the edges, with paper texture and grain.
油畫	Oil painting
把照片畫成油畫：細節變成一塊塊筆觸，順著畫面紋理的筆刷方向，還有顏料厚塗的立體光影。	Paint the photo as an oil painting: details become brush strokes following the image, with thick paint and raised highlights.
水墨畫	Ink wash
把照片畫成水墨：墨色分濃淡幾階、自然暈開，乾筆輪廓，宣紙底色與留白。	Paint the photo in ink wash: a few shades of ink that bleed naturally, dry-brush outlines, rice paper and empty space.
素描	Sketch
鉛筆素描：線稿加上暗部的斜向排線，石墨灰與紙紋。	Pencil sketch: line art with diagonal hatching in the shadows, graphite gray and paper texture.
彩色鉛筆	Colored pencil
彩色鉛筆畫：淡淡的顏色塗在兩個方向的鉛筆筆觸上，空隙露出白紙，加上鉛筆線稿。	Colored pencil drawing: light color over pencil strokes in two directions, white paper showing through, plus pencil lines.
點描	Pointillism
點描派（秀拉）：在白畫布上點滿一顆顆小色點，顏色略有變化、比較鮮豔。	Pointillism (Seurat): the white canvas filled with small dots of color that vary slightly and look brighter.
黑白漫畫	B&W manga
黑白漫畫：墨線輪廓，明暗分成黑、網點、白三階。	Black and white manga: ink outlines, with tones split into black, screen tone and white.
彩色漫畫	Color comic
動畫、美式漫畫風：平塗色塊、明暗分階、黑色輪廓線。	Anime and American comic style: flat colors, stepped shading and black outlines.
浮世繪	Ukiyo-e
日本浮世繪版畫：平塗色塊，顏色收斂到普魯士藍、朱紅、黃土、米白等，粗輪廓與和紙紋。	Japanese ukiyo-e print: flat colors limited to Prussian blue, vermilion, ochre, cream and so on, with bold outlines and washi texture.
銅版畫	Etching
銅版畫（蝕刻）：依明暗畫平行排線，越暗越密，最暗處交叉排線，米黃紙、深褐墨。	Copperplate etching: parallel hatching that gets denser in darker areas and cross-hatched in the darkest, on cream paper with dark brown ink.
木刻版畫	Woodcut
木刻版畫：黑白高反差，中間調刻出順著明暗走的白色刀痕，木紋紙底。	Woodcut: high-contrast black and white, with white cuts following the light in the midtones, on wood-grain paper.
普普藝術	Pop art
安迪沃荷風：亮度分四階換成鮮豔的對比色，中間色加網點，黑色輪廓。	Andy Warhol style: brightness in four steps mapped to bold contrasting colors, halftone dots in the midtones and black outlines.
像素藝術	Pixel art
復古電玩風：縮成大方塊、顏色限制在少數幾階。	Retro game style: shrunk into big blocks with only a few color levels.
「筆觸大小」決定方塊大小。	"Stroke size" sets the block size.
色調	Tone
調整顏色與明暗的濾鏡：鮮豔、日系清新、暖陽、冷調、夢幻。	Filters for color and brightness: Vivid, Japanese fresh, Warm sun, Cool, Dreamy.
復古／黑白	Retro / B&W
懷舊、老照片、黑白、高反差黑白、底片、電影感。	Nostalgic, Old photo, Black & white, High-contrast B&W, Film, Cinematic.
繪畫	Painting
把照片畫成水彩、油畫、水墨、素描、彩色鉛筆、點描。	Paint the photo as watercolor, oil, ink wash, sketch, colored pencil or pointillism.
縮圖是套在目前照片上的樣子；第一次算稍久一點。	Thumbnails show the style on the current photo; the first time takes a little longer.
漫畫／版畫	Comics
黑白漫畫、彩色漫畫、浮世繪、銅版畫、木刻版畫、普普藝術、像素藝術。	B&W manga, Color comic, Ukiyo-e, Etching, Woodcut, Pop art, Pixel art.
藝術風格	Art style
把照片畫成漫畫、水彩、油畫、水墨、版畫等（依分類列出）。選「無」關閉。	Turn the photo into a comic, watercolor, oil painting, ink wash, print and more (listed by category). Choose "None" to turn it off.
下方濾鏡列的「繪畫」「漫畫／版畫」分類會一次套用風格與適合的調色。	The "Painting" and "Comic / Print" categories in the filter strip apply a style and matching colors at once.
強度	Strength
藝術風格與原圖混合的比例：100 為完全風格化，調低保留一些照片的質感。	How much of the art style is mixed with the original: 100 is fully stylized; lower keeps some of the photo's texture.
線條	Lines
輪廓線的粗細（漫畫、版畫、水墨、素描的線條）。	Thickness of the outlines (lines in comic, print, ink wash and sketch).
筆觸大小	Stroke size
筆觸、網點、色塊、方塊的大小：越大越粗獷、越小越細緻。	Size of strokes, halftone dots, color patches and blocks: bigger is bolder, smaller is finer.
紙張	Paper
整份文件用的紙張或材質（類似 Corel Painter 的紙張）：素描紙、水彩紙、畫布、粉彩紙、宣紙、牛皮紙、麻布、磚牆、木板…	The paper or surface for the whole document (like Corel Painter papers): sketch paper, watercolor paper, canvas, pastel paper, rice paper, kraft paper, linen, brick wall, wood…
鉛筆、炭筆、粉筆、蠟筆、乾刷、水彩會吃紙紋（輕畫只碰到凸起、用力才填進凹處），水彩顏料沉積在凹處；藝術風格也用這張紙。換紙後筆畫自動重算。	Pencil, charcoal, chalk, crayon, dry brush and watercolor react to the paper grain (light strokes touch only the peaks, pressing harder fills the valleys), and watercolor pigment settles in the valleys; art styles use this paper too. Strokes are recalculated when you change paper.
「無」＝筆刷用原本的內建紋路。	"None" = brushes use their own built-in texture.
紙紋大小	Grain size
紙紋的粗細（100% 為標準）。	Coarseness of the paper grain (100% is standard).
紙紋深淺	Grain depth
紙紋凹凸的明顯程度，影響筆刷吃紙紋與表面紋理。	How pronounced the paper bumps are; affects how brushes react to the grain and the surface texture.
紙紋旋轉	Grain rotation
把紙紋轉一個角度（例如畫布斜紋、木紋方向）。	Turn the paper grain by an angle (e.g. the direction of canvas weave or wood grain).
凹凸反轉	Invert bumps
凸起與凹處對調。	Swap peaks and valleys.
匯入紙紋	Import paper
選一張圖片當紙紋：亮的地方是凸起，會自動平鋪。	Use a picture as paper grain: bright areas are peaks; it tiles automatically.
選了之後紙張換成「自訂」；圖片位置記在編輯檔裡，移動圖片後要重新匯入。	The paper becomes "Custom"; the picture's location is saved in the project, so import it again if you move the picture.
表面紋理	Surface texture
把紙紋壓印成光影，看起來像印在紙上或畫布上（0 為不壓印）。	Emboss the paper grain as light and shadow, as if printed on paper or canvas (0 = none).
作用在	Applies to
表面紋理壓印的範圍：整張照片（照片、文字、貼圖、繪圖一起），或只有繪圖圖層（照片本身不變）。	Where the surface texture is embossed: the whole photo (photo, text, stickers and drawings together), or drawing layers only (the photo itself is unchanged).
光源方向	Light direction
表面紋理的光從哪個方向來（135° 為左上）。	Which way the light comes from for the surface texture (135° is top left).
紙紋吃色	Paper grain effect
文件有紙張時，筆畫受紙紋影響的程度：越高越只畫到紙紋凸起（輕畫更明顯）。	How much strokes are affected by the paper when the document has paper: higher paints only the grain peaks (more visible with light strokes).
鉛筆、炭筆、粉筆、蠟筆、乾刷、水彩影響最大，其他筆刷只受三分之一；特效筆、紋理筆、貼圖噴槍不受影響。	Pencil, charcoal, chalk, crayon, dry brush and watercolor are affected most; other brushes only a third; FX, texture brushes and the sticker hose are not affected.
調	A
自動增強	Auto enhance
依照片的亮度分布，自動調整曝光、對比、暗部與白平衡。	Automatically adjust exposure, contrast, shadows and white balance based on the brightness of the photo.
結果不滿意可以再微調滑桿，或按 Ctrl+Z 復原。	If you don't like the result, fine-tune the sliders or press Ctrl+Z to undo.
自動白平衡	Auto white balance
去除偏黃、偏藍的色偏，讓白色看起來是白的。	Remove yellow or blue casts so white looks white.
室內燈光下拍的照片特別有用。	Especially useful for photos taken under indoor lighting.
曝光	Exposure
整張照片的亮度，單位是 EV（相機的曝光級數）。往右變亮、往左變暗。	Brightness of the whole photo in EV (camera exposure stops). Right is brighter, left is darker.
只想救回天空或陰影時，改用「亮部」「暗部」。	To recover only the sky or the shadows, use "Highlights" or "Shadows".
對比	Contrast
明暗的差距。往右讓亮的更亮、暗的更暗，照片更有力；往左變得柔和。	The difference between light and dark. Right makes lights lighter and darks darker for more punch; left makes it softer.
亮部	Highlights
只調整照片中亮的部分。往左可以救回過亮的天空與雲的層次。	Adjust only the bright parts. Move left to recover detail in a blown-out sky and clouds.
暗部	Shadows
只調整照片中暗的部分。往右可以看清逆光時臉上或陰影裡的細節。	Adjust only the dark parts. Move right to reveal detail in backlit faces or shadows.
色溫	Temperature
往右偏暖（黃橘），往左偏冷（藍）。	Right is warmer (yellow-orange), left is cooler (blue).
室內黃光可以往左修正；夕陽可以往右加強氣氛。	Move left to correct yellow indoor light; move right to warm up a sunset.
往右偏洋紅，往左偏綠。	Right adds magenta, left adds green.
日光燈下偏綠的照片可以往右修正。	Move right to fix the green cast of fluorescent light.
飽和度	Saturation
顏色的濃淡。往右更鮮豔，往左變淡；-100 是黑白。	Color intensity. Right is more vivid, left is paler; -100 is black and white.
銳利度	Sharpness
加強邊緣，讓細節更清楚。	Enhance edges so details look crisper.
放大到 100%（Ctrl+1）檢查；太高會出現白邊與雜訊。	Check at 100% (Ctrl+1); too much causes halos and noise.
效	E
暗角	Vignette
四周變暗（往左）或變亮（往右），讓視線集中在中央。	Darken (left) or brighten (right) the edges to draw the eye to the center.
褪色	Fade
把最暗的部分提亮成灰黑，像褪色的舊照片或底片。	Lift the darkest areas to gray, like a faded old print or film.
顆粒	Grain
加上底片般的顆粒感。	Add film-like grain.
放大檢視時看得最清楚。	Easiest to see when zoomed in.
色相	Hue
色彩濾鏡的顏色：0° 紅、35° 褐、60° 黃、120° 綠、200° 藍、280° 紫。	Color of the color filter: 0° red, 35° brown, 60° yellow, 120° green, 200° blue, 280° purple.
要搭配「強度」才有效果。	Works together with "Strength".
色彩濾鏡的強弱，0 為不套用。	Strength of the color filter; 0 means off.
例如：飽和度 -100 加上色相 35° 就是褐色老照片。	For example: saturation -100 with hue 35° gives a sepia old photo.
人	P
磨皮	Smooth skin
柔化臉部的膚質，去除細紋與斑點；眼睛、眉毛與嘴唇保持清晰。	Soften skin texture and remove fine lines and spots; eyes, brows and lips stay sharp.
建議 20～50，太高會顯得不自然。	20–50 is recommended; too high looks unnatural.
這張照片沒有偵測到人臉。	No face was detected in this photo.
臉部提亮	Brighten face
只把臉部調亮，背景不變，適合逆光或臉在陰影裡的照片。	Brighten only the face, not the background; good for backlit faces or faces in shadow.
亮眼	Brighten eyes
讓眼睛更明亮有神。	Make the eyes brighter and livelier.
少量就有效果，建議 30 以下。	A little goes a long way; 30 or below is recommended.
勻膚	Even skin tone
抹勻膚色的色塊與明暗不均（痘疤印、斑），毛孔等細紋理保留，比磨皮自然。	Even out blotches and uneven tones (acne marks, spots) while keeping fine texture like pores; more natural than smoothing.
可以和少量磨皮搭配。	Can be combined with a little smoothing.
去紅	Reduce redness
淡化泛紅：痘疤紅、鼻翼紅、臉頰潮紅。	Tone down redness: acne, the sides of the nose, flushed cheeks.
美白	Whiten
只把皮膚調亮、稍微降低飽和，衣服與背景不變。	Brighten only the skin and lower its saturation slightly; clothes and background are unchanged.
建議 20～50。	20–50 is recommended.
膚色	Skin tone
往左白皙偏冷（粉嫩），往右健康小麥色。	Left is fair and cool (rosy), right is a healthy tan.
去油光	Reduce shine
壓低額頭、鼻頭、臉頰的反光亮點。	Tone down the shiny spots on the forehead, nose and cheeks.
去痘	Remove blemishes
自動找出皮膚上的小斑點、痘痘，用周圍的膚色補掉；數值越高找到的越多。	Find small spots and pimples on the skin automatically and fill them with the surrounding skin; higher values find more.
較大的斑點請用「修補」分頁的修補筆刷。	For bigger blemishes use the healing brush on the "Retouch" tab.
黑眼圈	Dark circles
淡化眼睛下方的暗沉與青紫色。	Lighten the darkness and bluish tint under the eyes.
大眼	Bigger eyes
以眼睛為中心局部放大。	Enlarge around the eyes.
建議 30 以下，太大會不自然。	30 or below is recommended; too much looks unnatural.
牙齒美白	Whiten teeth
去掉牙齒的黃色並提亮（兩個嘴角之間偏白的地方）。	Remove the yellow from teeth and brighten them (the whitish area between the corners of the mouth).
沒露牙齒時沒有作用。	Has no effect when no teeth are showing.
腮紅	Blush
在兩頰加上柔和的腮紅；顏色在下一列選。	Add soft blush to both cheeks; pick the color on the next row.
修容	Contour
鼻樑與額頭中央打亮、顴骨下方與下顎兩側加陰影，臉更立體。	Highlight the nose bridge and center of the forehead, and shade below the cheekbones and along the jaw for a more sculpted face.
瘦臉	Slim face
兩頰往臉的中線收，臉看起來比較窄。	Pull the cheeks toward the center so the face looks narrower.
建議 30 以下；背景有直線時注意是否被拉彎。	30 or below is recommended; watch out for straight lines in the background bending.
V 臉	V-shape face
下顎兩側往內收，下巴變尖。	Pull in both sides of the jaw for a pointed chin.
下巴	Chin
往左縮短下巴、往右拉長。	Left shortens the chin, right lengthens it.
瘦鼻	Slim nose
鼻翼往內收，鼻子看起來比較窄。	Pull in the sides of the nose so it looks narrower.
唇色	Lip color
替嘴唇上色（牙齒與嘴裡不上色），保留原本的明暗與紋路；顏色在下一列選。	Color the lips (not the teeth or inside the mouth), keeping the original shading and texture; pick the color on the next row.
眉毛	Eyebrows
讓淡的眉毛加深、更清楚。	Make faint eyebrows darker and clearer.
曬黑	Tan
臉和照片裡其他露出的皮膚（脖子、手臂）一起變成深色、偏暖，比「膚色」的小麥色更深（辣妹妝的黑辣妹）。	The face and other visible skin (neck, arms) become darker and warmer together, deeper than the tan of "Skin tone" (gyaru tanned look).
整張照片一起處理，臉和身體顏色才一致。	The whole photo is processed so the face and body match.
嘴角上揚	Smile
兩個嘴角往上推一點，表情比較有笑意。	Push both corners of the mouth up a little for a happier expression.
建議 40 以下。	40 or below is recommended.
豐唇	Fuller lips
往右上下唇變厚、往左變薄（只推嘴唇外緣，牙齒不動）。	Right makes the lips fuller, left thinner (only the outer edge of the lips moves, not the teeth).
開眼角	Extend eye corners
內眼角往鼻樑、外眼角往外延伸，眼睛看起來比較長。	Extend the inner corners toward the nose and the outer corners outward so the eyes look longer.
美妝樣式	Makeup style
點一下套用這個樣式；小圖是這張臉套上去的樣子（目前的顏色）。濃度是 0 時點了會自動設成 50。	Click to apply this style; the thumbnail shows it on this face (current colors). If the strength is 0 it is set to 50 automatically.
選了眼妝或口紅時，左邊預覽會放大到那個部位。	When eye makeup or lipstick is selected, the preview on the left zooms in on that area.
這項歸零	Reset this item
目前這個分類的濃度設成 0（樣式與顏色保留，之後再開就回來）。	Set the strength of the current category to 0 (style and color are kept and come back if you turn it on again).
宮崎風 AI 重繪	Ghibli AI redraw
用電腦的顯卡把照片重新畫成吉卜力風的手繪動畫（約 30 秒）。保留本人的五官位置與比例，五官簡化、膚色溫暖。	Use your graphics card to redraw the photo as a Ghibli-style hand-drawn animation (about 30 seconds). The person's features keep their position and proportions, simplified, with warm skin tones.
結果另存成新影像（圖片\\PhotoEdit\\AI重繪），原照片不變。需要 Models\\GhibliDiffusion 模型。	The result is saved as a new image (Pictures\\PhotoEdit\\AI Redraw); the original photo is unchanged. Requires the Models\\GhibliDiffusion model.
第二張圖	Second image
選要變成的那張圖（例如野狼）。是人臉時點位會自動對好；不是人臉時，依提示在圖上依序點兩眼、鼻尖、兩嘴角，其他點會自動推估過去。	Pick the image to morph into (for example a wolf). Points line up automatically for human faces; otherwise click the two eyes, the nose tip and the two mouth corners in order as prompted, and the other points are estimated.
對應點	Matching points
兩張圖相同編號、相同顏色的點是一對：第一張的這個部位會變到第二張的那個位置。左鍵拖點、空白處點一下加點（另一張自動放到對應位置）、右鍵點刪除、滾輪縮放、中鍵拖曳平移、Ctrl+Z 復原。	Points with the same number and color in both images form a pair: this part of the first image moves to that position in the second. Drag points with the left button, click empty space to add a point (the other image gets a matching one), right-click to delete, scroll to zoom, drag with the middle button to pan, Ctrl+Z to undo.
重設點位	Reset points
回到自動放的點位（第二張不是人臉時要重新點 5 個關鍵點）。	Go back to the automatic points (if the second image is not a face, click the 5 key points again).
點位檔	Points file
把兩張圖的點位存成 .morph.json，下次讀回來接著調；圖片大小不同時依比例換算。	Save the points of both images as a .morph.json to continue later; points are scaled if the image sizes differ.
預覽	Preview
拖動看變形到一半的樣子（0%＝第一張、100%＝第二張）；播放會來回播。	Drag to see the morph partway (0% = first image, 100% = second image); play goes back and forth.
對齊	Align
第二張圖怎麼放到畫面上：0%＝整張填滿畫面，100%＝兩眼和第一張完全重疊。兩張圖大小、位置差很多時調高，動畫晃動較少；調太高第二張可能被裁掉一部分。	How the second image is placed: 0% = fill the whole frame, 100% = its eyes exactly over the first image's eyes. Raise it when the images differ a lot in size or position for less wobble; too high may crop part of the second image.
時間	Timing
變形秒數＝從第一張變到第二張花多久；開頭停、結尾停＝前後各停在原圖幾秒。	Morph seconds = how long the change from the first to the second image takes; hold at start/end = how many seconds to stay on each original.
變過去再變回來	Morph there and back
變到第二張後再變回第一張，適合循環播放。	Morph to the second image and back to the first; good for looping.
慢入慢出	Ease in and out
開始與結束時變得比較慢，中間比較快，看起來比較自然。	Slower at the start and end, faster in the middle, for a more natural look.
輸出大小	Output size
影片的長邊像素（比例跟第一張相同）。超過第一張原本的大小時不會再放大。GIF 最大 480。	Long side of the video in pixels (same proportions as the first image). It never enlarges beyond the first image's original size. GIF is at most 480.
存成 MP4	Save as MP4
H.264 影片（電腦、手機都能播）。程式資料夾有 Cisco 的 OpenH264 時檔案小很多；沒有時用系統內建的編碼器（檔案大 3～4 倍）；都不行時改用 MPEG-4。	H.264 video (plays on computers and phones). With Cisco OpenH264 in the program folder the file is much smaller; otherwise the built-in system encoder is used (3–4 times larger); if neither works MPEG-4 is used.
存成 GIF	Save as GIF
動態 GIF（適合貼到聊天軟體），長邊最大 480、每秒 15 格、256 色，檔案比 MP4 大。	Animated GIF (good for chat apps): long side at most 480, 15 frames per second, 256 colors; larger than MP4.
模型	Model
吉卜力電影風：像吉卜力電影的畫面，比較寫實、成熟。動畫插畫風：臉較圓、腮紅明顯，乾淨可愛的動畫插畫。	Ghibli movie: looks like a frame from a Ghibli film, more realistic and mature. Anime illustration: rounder faces, visible blush, clean and cute anime illustration.
風格	Style
柔和：最像本人、臉部明暗最少。電影：側光與髮絲陰影。沉穩：色調較深、表情沉穩。快速動畫（動畫插畫風）：不用線稿控制，約 10 秒，畫風自由一點。	Soft: closest to the person, least shading on the face. Cinematic: side light and shadows from the hair. Calm: darker tones and a calm expression. Quick anime (anime illustration): no line-art control, about 10 seconds, a freer style.
重繪強度	Redraw strength
越高越像動畫、越不像照片；太高會開始改動五官與髮型。建議 0.40～0.55。	Higher looks more like animation and less like the photo; too high starts changing the features and hair. 0.40–0.55 is recommended.
種子	Seed
同樣的種子與設定會畫出同樣的結果；換一個種子就是另一種畫法。「隨機」隨便挑一個。	The same seed and settings produce the same result; a different seed gives a different drawing. "Random" picks one.
畫面描述	Description
用英文描述照片裡的東西（例如 dark grey newsboy cap, white t-shirt, wooden wall），帽子、衣服、背景會畫得更準。可以空白。	Describe what is in the photo in English (e.g. dark grey newsboy cap, white t-shirt, wooden wall) so hats, clothes and background are drawn more accurately. Can be left empty.
生成	Generate
開始重畫（用顯卡，約 30 秒）。進行中可以按「停止」。	Start redrawing (on the graphics card, about 30 seconds). Click "Stop" while it runs to cancel.
開成新影像	Open as new image
把右邊的結果存成新檔（圖片\\PhotoEdit\\AI重繪）並打開，原照片不變。	Save the result on the right as a new file (Pictures\\PhotoEdit\\AI Redraw) and open it; the original photo is unchanged.
戲曲分組	Opera groups
俊扮：生、旦的美化妝（白底、眼周胭脂、吊眉）。臉譜：淨角，整張臉畫成另一張臉，顏色代表性格。丑角：鼻樑一塊白的小花臉。川劇：臉上畫蝴蝶、蝙蝠、火焰、雲紋等圖形，掃帚眉、白眼斑、金銀色，比京劇華麗。	Jun-ban: beautifying makeup for male and female roles (white base, rouge around the eyes, lifted brows). Painted faces: jing roles, the whole face painted as another face, with colors showing character. Clown: a small white patch on the nose. Sichuan opera: butterflies, bats, flames and cloud patterns on the face, broom brows, white eye patches, gold and silver; more ornate than Peking opera.
戲曲角色	Opera role
點一下套用這個角色的妝；小圖是這張臉畫上去的樣子。臉譜、丑角會整張臉重畫，一般美妝（口紅、眼影、腮紅…）先不套用。	Click to apply this role's makeup; the thumbnail shows it on this face. Painted faces and clowns repaint the whole face, and regular makeup (lipstick, eye shadow, blush…) is not applied for now.
清除戲曲妝	Clear opera makeup
拿掉戲曲妝，其他美顏、美妝保留。	Remove the opera makeup; other beauty and makeup settings are kept.
變臉影片	Face-changing video
把這張照片做成川劇變臉的影片：依序換上幾張臉譜（扯臉、抹臉、吹臉），可以輸出 MP4、GIF。	Turn this photo into a Sichuan opera face-changing video: several painted faces appear in turn (pull, wipe, blow), exported as MP4 or GIF.
拖動看影片某一刻的樣子；播放會從頭播到尾再重來。	Drag to see a moment in the video; play runs from start to end and repeats.
臉譜順序	Mask order
打勾的臉譜依清單順序變；選一列再按上移、下移調整順序。川劇的排在前面，也可以用京劇臉譜。	Checked masks change in list order; select a row and click Up or Down to reorder. Sichuan masks come first; Peking opera masks can be used too.
本人	Real face
開頭先看本人：影片從原本的臉開始。最後露出本人：最後一張變回原本的臉（川劇變臉常見的收尾）。	Start with the real face: the video begins with the original face. End with the real face: the last change reveals the original face (a common Sichuan finale).
每張停留＝每張臉譜停多久；換臉時間＝一次換臉的動作多快（0.3 秒左右最像現場）。	Hold per mask = how long each mask stays; change time = how fast each change is (about 0.3 seconds looks most like the real thing).
換臉方式	Change style
扯臉：臉譜從一側被快速扯開。抹臉：手從下巴往額頭一抹。吹臉：一陣煙霧閃過就換了。三種輪流：依序交替。	Pull: the mask is pulled away to one side. Wipe: a hand wipes from chin to forehead. Blow: a puff of smoke and it changes. All three: alternate in turn.
貼片子	Hair pieces
旦角額頭一排小彎、兩頰兩條長髮片，把臉修成瓜子臉。	A row of small curls on the forehead and two long pieces on the cheeks for female roles, shaping the face into an oval.
髯口	Beard
戲曲的假鬍子：三綹、滿髯（蓋住嘴）或紮髯，依角色而定。	Opera false beards: three-strand, full (covering the mouth) or tied, depending on the role.
戲曲妝濃度	Opera makeup strength
整組戲曲妝的強弱。	Strength of the whole opera makeup.
吊眉	Lifted eyes
模擬勒頭：把眼尾、眉尾往太陽穴上方拉，眼睛變成上挑的鳳眼。	Simulates the head binding: pulls the outer corners of the eyes and brows up toward the temples for upturned phoenix eyes.
保留明暗	Keep shading
0＝平塗（像貼紙）；越高越像真的畫在臉上，鼻樑、顴骨的立體感還在。	0 = flat (like a sticker); higher looks more like paint on a real face, keeping the shape of the nose bridge and cheekbones.
存成我的妝容	Save as my look
把目前全部的設定（含肌膚、五官、美妝、光影）存成一組，取名後出現在「我的妝容」和人像頁一鍵美顏的最後面。	Save all current settings (skin, features, makeup, lighting) as a set; give it a name and it appears in "My looks" and at the end of one-click beauty on the Portrait tab.
刪除這組	Delete this set
刪除目前選的我的妝容。	Delete the selected look.
唇色顏色	Lip color
選唇色（預設玫瑰色）。	Pick the lip color (rose by default).
選了顏色而唇色是 0 時，會自動設成 40。	If lip color is 0 when you pick a color, it is set to 40 automatically.
套用到	Apply to
美顏滑桿要調整哪張臉：「全部的臉」共用一組；選「臉 N」可以單獨調整那張臉（團體照）。	Which face the beauty sliders adjust: "All faces" share one set; choose "Face N" to adjust that face alone (group photos).
臉的編號由左到右；選了某張臉時畫面上會標出來。第一次調整某張臉時，會從共用的數值開始。	Faces are numbered left to right; the selected face is marked on the picture. The first time you adjust a face it starts from the shared values.
照片裡只有一張臉時不需要選。	Not needed when there is only one face in the photo.
跟隨全部	Follow all
這張臉不再單獨設定，改回跟「全部的臉」一樣。	Stop using separate settings for this face and use the same as "All faces".
目前沒有選某張臉，或這張臉沒有個別設定。	No face is selected, or this face has no separate settings.
一鍵美顏	One-click beauty
點一下小圖套用整組美顏；小圖是這張照片的臉套上該組的樣子。	Click a thumbnail to apply a whole beauty set; the thumbnail shows it on the face in this photo.
膚質：自然、清透、嬰兒肌、證件照、減齡、自拍補光；膚色：甜美、冷白皮、小麥肌、好氣色；臉型：精緻小臉；男性：男性、清爽男生；	Skin: Natural, Clear, Baby skin, ID photo, Younger, Selfie light; Skin tone: Sweet, Cool fair, Tan, Healthy glow; Face shape: Delicate small face; Men: Male, Fresh guy;
妝容：韓系淡妝、桃花妝、歐美妝；光影：柔光、林布蘭光、側光。「原圖」全部清除。	Makeup: Korean natural, Peach blossom, Western; Lighting: Soft light, Rembrandt, Side light. "Original" clears everything.
套到「套用到」選的對象；用「強度」調濃淡，細節在「手動調整…」。臉型、妝容需要 68 點特徵點。	Applies to the target chosen in "Apply to"; use "Strength" for intensity and "Manual adjust…" for details. Face shape and makeup need 68 facial landmarks.
目前這組一鍵美顏的濃淡（0～100%），整組數值等比例縮放。	Intensity of the current one-click beauty set (0–100%); all its values scale proportionally.
手動調整過（自訂）時停用。	Disabled after manual (custom) adjustments.
先點一組一鍵美顏。	Click a one-click beauty set first.
手動調整	Manual adjust
開一個視窗調整每一項：肌膚、五官、臉型與唇眉、妝容（眼影、眼線、臥蠶）、光影；左邊臉部放大即時預覽。	Open a window to adjust each item: skin, features, face shape and lips/brows, makeup (eye shadow, eyeliner, aegyo sal), lighting; with a live zoomed preview of the face on the left.
按「確定」才套到照片，Ctrl+Z 一步復原；多張臉時可以在視窗裡切換要調哪一張。	Changes apply to the photo only when you click "OK", and Ctrl+Z undoes them in one step; with several faces you can switch faces in the window.
全部歸零	Reset all
目前這個對象的美顏全部清掉（包含顏色、光影）。	Clear all beauty settings for this target (including colors and lighting).
光影	Lighting
柔光：臉部柔和提亮；林布蘭光：一側亮一側暗，暗側臉頰留一塊三角光；側光：單側打光、對比強。可選光從左或右。	Soft light: softly brightens the face; Rembrandt: one side lit and one dark, with a triangle of light on the dark cheek; Side light: lit from one side with strong contrast. Light can come from left or right.
以整張臉為範圍（含頭髮），強度在下一列。	Covers the whole face (including hair); strength is on the next row.
眼影	Eye shadow
在上眼皮塗上眼影（眼睛本身不上色）；顏色在右邊的色塊選。	Apply eye shadow to the upper eyelids (not the eyes themselves); pick the color in the swatch on the right.
眼線	Eyeliner
沿上眼皮畫一條深色細線，眼尾微微上揚。	Draw a thin dark line along the upper eyelid with a slight upward flick at the end.
臥蠶	Aegyo sal
下眼皮下方一條提亮、再下面淡淡的陰影，眼睛看起來比較有笑意。	A highlight just below the lower lid with a faint shadow underneath, so the eyes look smiling.
光影強度	Lighting strength
光影效果的強弱。	Strength of the lighting effect.
先在上一列選種類。	Pick a type on the row above first.
腮紅顏色	Blush color
選腮紅的顏色（預設柔粉色）。	Pick the blush color (soft pink by default).
選了顏色而腮紅是 0 時，會自動設成 35。	If blush is 0 when you pick a color, it is set to 35 automatically.
按住看未美顏	Hold to see without beauty
按住時暫時拿掉美顏與液化，放開恢復；其他調整保留。	While held, beauty and liquify are temporarily removed; release to restore. Other adjustments stay.
右下角的「按住看原圖」是連全部調整都拿掉。	"Hold to compare" in the lower right removes all adjustments.
液化筆刷	Liquify brush
在照片上推、拉、放大、縮小、旋轉局部，可以手動瘦臉、修下巴、調整身形。	Push, pull, expand, shrink or twist parts of the photo to slim a face, fix a chin or reshape a figure by hand.
快捷鍵 L；Esc 結束。每一筆放開滑鼠後套用，Ctrl+Z 可復原。	Shortcut L; Esc to finish. Each stroke applies when you release the mouse; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
液化模式	Liquify mode
推移：沿著拖曳方向推動（瘦臉往內推）；膨脹：放大筆刷中心；縮攏：縮小；旋轉：順時針或逆時針扭轉。	Push: moves pixels along the drag (push inward to slim a face); Bloat: enlarges the brush center; Pucker: shrinks it; Twirl: twists clockwise or counterclockwise.
膨脹、縮攏、旋轉按一下就有效果，按越多次越明顯。	Bloat, pucker and twirl work with a single click; more clicks make it stronger.
液化筆刷大小	Liquify brush size
筆刷半徑（螢幕像素）。	Brush radius (screen pixels).
瘦臉用大筆刷、慢慢推比較自然。	For slimming a face, a big brush pushed slowly looks more natural.
液化力道	Liquify strength
每一筆變形的強度。	How strongly each stroke deforms.
力道小、多推幾次比較好控制。	Low strength with several pushes is easier to control.
清除液化	Clear liquify
移除全部的液化筆觸。	Remove all liquify strokes.
只想取消最後一筆請按 Ctrl+Z。	To undo only the last stroke, press Ctrl+Z.
依人臉自動裁切：臉群水平置中、眼睛落在上方三分線，並進入裁切模式讓你微調。	Crop by faces automatically: faces centered horizontally, eyes on the upper third, then crop mode opens so you can fine-tune.
也在「影像 → 智慧構圖」與裁切列。	Also in "Image → Smart Composition" and the crop bar.
修	R
修補筆刷	Healing brush
在照片上塗抹要移除的污點、電線、路人或雜物，放開滑鼠就會用附近相似的紋理補上。	Paint over spots, wires, passers-by or clutter to remove them; release the mouse and they are filled with similar texture from nearby.
快捷鍵 H；[ ] 調整筆刷大小、右鍵拖曳平移、Esc 結束。補得不好就按 Ctrl+Z 再塗一次。	Shortcut H; [ ] change brush size, right-drag to pan, Esc to finish. If the fill is poor, press Ctrl+Z and paint again.
清除全部修補	Clear all healing
移除這張照片所有的修補筆觸，回到修補前的樣子。	Remove all healing strokes from this photo and return to how it was before.
只想取消最後一筆，按 Ctrl+Z。	To undo only the last stroke, press Ctrl+Z.
筆刷大小	Brush size
修補筆刷的半徑（像素）。筆刷比污點稍大一點效果最好。	Radius of the healing brush (pixels). A brush slightly bigger than the spot works best.
快捷鍵 [ 縮小、] 放大。	Shortcut [ to shrink, ] to enlarge.
明度降噪	Luminance noise
減少顆粒狀的雜訊，適合夜景與高 ISO 照片。	Reduce grainy noise; good for night scenes and high-ISO photos.
太高會讓細節變得像塗抹過。	Too high makes details look smeared.
色彩降噪	Color noise
去除暗部常見的紅綠色彩色雜點，對細節的影響很小。	Remove the red and green color speckles common in shadows, with little effect on detail.
垂直透視	Vertical perspective
修正仰拍建築物上窄下寬的變形：往右放大上緣，往左放大下緣。	Fix buildings shot from below that look narrow at the top: right enlarges the top edge, left enlarges the bottom edge.
四周會自動裁掉，不會出現空白。	The edges are trimmed automatically so no blank areas appear.
水平透視	Horizontal perspective
修正斜著拍的牆面或招牌：往右放大左緣，往左放大右緣。	Fix walls or signs shot at an angle: right enlarges the left edge, left enlarges the right edge.
旋轉照片讓地平線變水平，每格 0.5°；四周自動裁掉。	Rotate the photo to level the horizon, 0.5° per step; the edges are trimmed automatically.
不確定角度時用「自動拉直」。	If you are unsure of the angle, use "Auto straighten".
自動拉直	Auto straighten
偵測畫面中的水平線與垂直線（地平線、建築物），自動決定拉直角度。	Detect horizontal and vertical lines in the picture (horizon, buildings) and choose the straightening angle automatically.
找不到明顯線條時不會改動。	Nothing changes if no clear lines are found.
裁切	Crop
在照片上拖曳畫出要保留的範圍：拖四角或四邊調整大小、框內拖曳移動；也能選比例、形狀、輸入尺寸、拉直與旋轉。	Drag on the photo to draw the area to keep: drag the corners or sides to resize, drag inside to move; you can also choose a ratio, shape, type a size, straighten and rotate.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+K；Enter 套用、Esc 取消。	Shortcut Ctrl+K; Enter to apply, Esc to cancel.
局	L
＋ 漸層濾鏡	+ Graduated filter
加入一個漸層範圍：在照片上從效果最強處拖曳到效果消失處，再用下面的滑桿調整。	Add a gradient area: drag on the photo from where the effect is strongest to where it fades out, then adjust with the sliders below.
例如壓暗天空：從畫面上緣往下拖到地平線，曝光往左。	For example, to darken the sky: drag down from the top edge to the horizon and move exposure left.
＋ 局部筆刷	+ Local brush
加入一個筆刷範圍：在照片上塗抹要調整的區域，再用下面的滑桿調整。	Add a brush area: paint the region to adjust, then adjust with the sliders below.
可以分好幾筆塗；換別的局部調整前，同一個範圍可以繼續加塗。	You can paint in several strokes; until you switch to another local adjustment, you can keep adding to the same area.
局部調整清單	Local adjustments
這張照片所有的局部調整；選一個就能用下面的滑桿修改它的效果。	All local adjustments on this photo; select one to change its effect with the sliders below.
還沒有任何局部調整。	No local adjustments yet.
刪除局部調整	Delete local adjustment
刪除清單裡選取的局部調整。	Delete the local adjustment selected in the list.
局部曝光	Local exposure
只讓選取的範圍變亮或變暗。	Brighten or darken only the selected area.
局部對比	Local contrast
只調整選取範圍的明暗差距。	Adjust light and dark difference only in the selected area.
局部飽和度	Local saturation
只讓選取範圍的顏色更鮮豔或更淡。	Make colors more vivid or paler only in the selected area.
例如只加強天空的藍。	For example, boost only the blue of the sky.
局部色溫	Local temperature
只讓選取範圍偏暖或偏冷。	Make only the selected area warmer or cooler.
局部筆刷的半徑（像素）。	Radius of the local brush (pixels).
[ ] 鍵也可以調整。	The [ ] keys work too.
先選取一個「局部筆刷」。	Select a "Local brush" first.
背景模糊	Background blur
保留人物清楚、把背景模糊，像大光圈鏡頭的淺景深。	Keep people sharp and blur the background, like the shallow depth of field of a wide-aperture lens.
依偵測到的人臉推估頭與上半身；沒有臉時保留畫面中央。	The head and upper body are estimated from detected faces; without faces the center is kept.
移軸	Tilt-shift
上下模糊、中間留一條清楚帶，讓風景看起來像微縮模型。	Blur the top and bottom and leave a sharp band in the middle, so scenery looks like a miniature model.
從高處往下拍的街景、車站效果最好。	Works best on street or station scenes shot from high up.
清楚帶位置	Sharp band position
移軸清楚帶的高度：0 = 上緣、50 = 中央、100 = 下緣。	Height of the tilt-shift sharp band: 0 = top edge, 50 = center, 100 = bottom edge.
先把「移軸」調到 0 以上。	Set "Tilt-shift" above 0 first.
裝	D
邊框樣式	Frame style
白邊、黑邊、拍立得（下方較寬）、圓角、底片（片孔）。選「無」取消邊框。	White border, black border, Polaroid (wider at the bottom), rounded corners, film (sprocket holes). Choose "None" to remove the frame.
邊框加在照片外圍，匯出後的尺寸會變大。	The frame is added outside the photo, so the exported size gets bigger.
邊框寬度	Frame width
邊框的粗細；圓角樣式則是圓角的大小。	Thickness of the frame; for the rounded style, the size of the corners.
貼	S
重新整理	Refresh
重新讀取 stick 資料夾：新增或刪除貼圖、主題資料夾後按這裡。	Reload the stick folder: click here after adding or deleting stickers or theme folders.
貼圖小幫手	Sticker Helper
把一張排了很多貼圖的圖（例如 LINE 貼圖預覽圖）自動拆成一張張、去背，存進貼圖資料夾。	Split a picture with many stickers laid out (such as a LINE sticker preview) into separate stickers, remove their backgrounds and save them to the sticker folder.
開啟獨立視窗，可以一邊看主畫面一邊處理。	Opens in its own window so you can keep the main window in view.
開啟圖片	Open image
選一張排了很多貼圖的圖片，開啟後會自動拆分。	Pick a picture with many stickers; it is split automatically after opening.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+O。	Shortcut Ctrl+O.
貼上圖片	Paste image
把剪貼簿裡的圖片（截圖、網頁複製的圖）貼進來拆分。	Paste the picture on the clipboard (a screenshot, an image copied from a web page) to split it.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+V；也可以貼上檔案總管複製的圖片檔。	Shortcut Ctrl+V; you can also paste an image file copied in File Explorer.
背景	Background
拆分與去背時當作背景的顏色。「自動」取圖片四邊最常見的顏色；背景不是單一顏色時可以「指定顏色」。	The color treated as background when splitting and removing backgrounds. "Auto" uses the most common color along the four edges; use "Pick color" when the background is not a single color.
右邊的色塊是目前的背景色；PNG 透明背景會自動當作透明。	The swatch on the right is the current background color; PNG transparent backgrounds are treated as transparent automatically.
合併距離	Merge distance
距離多近的東西算同一張貼圖：貼圖旁的愛心、星星、放射線離主角有一點距離時，調大一點就會併進來。	How close things must be to count as one sticker: when hearts, stars or rays sit a little away from the main figure, increase it to merge them in.
調大：兩張貼圖靠太近時可能被併成一張；調小：小裝飾可能被拆成獨立的一張。	Larger: two stickers that are very close may merge into one; smaller: small decorations may split into a sticker of their own.
最小尺寸	Minimum size
比這個小的東西不算一張貼圖（去掉零星的雜點、小字）。	Things smaller than this don't count as a sticker (drops stray specks and small text).
重新拆分	Split again
用目前的背景、合併距離、最小尺寸重新拆分。	Split again using the current background, merge distance and minimum size.
會清除每張貼圖的修正（會先詢問）。	Corrections on each sticker are cleared (you will be asked first).
原圖	Original
綠框是找到的貼圖，紅色虛線是排除的。點框選取、按兩下或點左上角編號排除／加回。	Green boxes are stickers found, red dashed boxes are excluded. Click a box to select it; double-click or click the number at the top left to exclude or include it.
拖曳框的邊或角調整範圍、框內拖曳移動；在框上按右鍵可以把它拆成 2～4 張；右鍵拖曳補畫一個框；Del 刪除選取的框。	Drag a box's edge or corner to resize, drag inside to move; right-click a box to split it into 2–4; right-drag to draw an extra box; Del deletes the selected box.
全部去背	Remove all backgrounds
每一張都改用「背景色填充」去背。	Use "Background fill" removal on every sticker.
全部原圖	Keep all originals
每一張都不去背，保留原本的背景。	Don't remove the background of any sticker; keep the original background.
之後還可以逐張切回去背，先前的修正會保留。	You can still switch each one back later; earlier corrections are kept.
全選	Select all
勾選全部貼圖（都會存）。	Check all stickers (all will be saved).
全不選	Select none
取消勾選全部貼圖，再逐張勾選要存的。	Uncheck all stickers, then check the ones to save one by one.
拆分出的貼圖	Split stickers
點一下在下方修正；點左下角的勾選框決定要不要存這張。	Click one to correct it below; the check box at the bottom left decides whether it is saved.
下面的數字是貼圖的像素大小。	The numbers below are the sticker size in pixels.
背景色填充	Background fill
從四邊往內把背景色去掉；被線條包住的同色（眼白、白衣服）會保留。白底插圖最適合。	Remove the background color from the four edges inward; areas of the same color enclosed by lines (whites of the eyes, white clothes) are kept. Best for illustrations on white.
邊緣有殘留時調「背景容許度」。	If traces remain at the edges, adjust "Background tolerance".
AI 一般	AI general
用 AI 找出主體去背（人、動物、物品），適合照片類貼圖。	Use AI to find the subject (people, animals, objects) and remove the background; good for photo-style stickers.
第一次使用要載入模型，需要幾秒鐘。	The model loads the first time, which takes a few seconds.
AI 人像	AI portrait
用 AI 人像模型去背，人物的輪廓與頭髮比較準。	Use the AI portrait model; outlines and hair of people are more accurate.
不去背	Keep background
這張保留原本的背景。	Keep this sticker's original background.
魔術棒	Magic wand
在下方的貼圖上點一下，去掉相近的顏色；Alt＋點一下補回。	Click on the sticker below to remove similar colors; Alt+click adds them back.
快捷鍵 W；範圍用「魔術棒」滑桿調整（會改最後一次點擊）。	Shortcut W; set the range with the "Magic wand" slider (it changes the last click).
保留筆刷	Restore brush
塗抹被誤去掉的地方，把它補回來。	Paint over areas removed by mistake to bring them back.
大小用「筆刷」滑桿調整。	Set the size with the "Brush" slider.
擦除筆刷	Erase brush
塗抹沒去乾淨的地方，把它擦掉。	Paint over leftover areas to erase them.
檢查遮罩	Check mask
用紅色顯示被去掉的部分，方便找出漏掉或多去的地方。	Show removed parts in red so missed or over-removed areas are easy to find.
復原	Undo
取消這張貼圖的上一個修正。	Undo the last correction on this sticker.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+Z；每張貼圖各自記錄。	Shortcut Ctrl+Z; each sticker keeps its own history.
放大修正	Enlarge correction view
隱藏上方的縮圖，讓修正區變大；再按一次恢復。	Hide the thumbnails above to make the correction area bigger; click again to restore.
修正區也可以用滾輪縮放、右鍵拖曳平移。	The correction area can also be zoomed with the wheel and panned with a right-drag.
背景容許度	Background tolerance
背景色填充時，和背景差多少以內也算背景。邊緣留下一圈白邊時調大，主體被吃掉時調小。	For background fill, how far from the background color still counts as background. Increase it when a white rim is left; decrease it when the subject gets eaten.
魔術棒相似程度	Magic wand tolerance
最後一次魔術棒點擊的範圍：越大選得越廣。	Range of the last magic wand click: larger selects more.
保留／擦除筆刷的大小（螢幕像素）。	Size of the restore and erase brushes (screen pixels).
羽化	Feather
讓去背的邊緣柔和一點，避免鋸齒。	Soften the cutout edges a little to avoid jagged edges.
內縮外擴	Edge shift
往左把邊緣往內縮（去掉殘留的背景邊），往右往外擴。	Left shrinks the edge inward (removing leftover background edge); right expands it outward.
存到主題	Save to theme
貼圖要存到哪個主題（stick 資料夾裡的子資料夾）；輸入新名稱就會建立新主題。	Which theme to save the stickers into (a subfolder of the stick folder); type a new name to create a new theme.
檔名	File name
檔名開頭，後面自動加上編號，例如「女孩_01.png」。	Start of the file name; a number is added automatically, e.g. "girl_01.png".
同名的檔案不會被覆蓋，會自動跳到下一個編號。	Existing files are never overwritten; the next number is used instead.
剪掉透明邊	Trim transparent edges
存檔時把四周透明的部分剪掉，貼圖剛好包住內容。	Trim the transparent area around each sticker when saving, so it fits the content exactly.
存成貼圖	Save as stickers
把勾選的貼圖存成透明 PNG，存好後主畫面的貼圖分頁會自動切到這個主題。	Save the checked stickers as transparent PNGs; afterwards the Stickers tab of the main window switches to this theme.
關閉	Close
關閉貼圖小幫手。	Close the Sticker Helper.
主題	Theme
切換要顯示的貼圖主題，括號內是貼圖張數。「內建」是程式附的 34 款向量貼圖（可以改顏色、加陰影與發光）。	Switch the sticker theme to display; the number in parentheses is the sticker count. "Built-in" is the 34 vector stickers that come with the program (you can change their colors and add shadow and glow).
每個主題是 stick 資料夾裡的一個子資料夾；也可以用兩旁的 ◀ ▶ 依序切換。	Each theme is a subfolder of the stick folder; you can also step through them with the ◀ ▶ buttons on either side.
上一個主題	Previous theme
切換到清單中的上一個主題（到第一個時會跳到最後一個）。	Switch to the previous theme in the list (from the first it wraps to the last).
下一個主題	Next theme
切換到清單中的下一個主題（到最後一個時會跳回第一個）。	Switch to the next theme in the list (from the last it wraps to the first).
把貼圖拖到照片上就貼在那個位置；在貼圖上按兩下則貼在照片中央。	Drag a sticker onto the photo to place it there; double-click a sticker to place it in the center of the photo.
貼上後：拖曳移動、拖曳角落縮放、拖曳上方圓點旋轉，Del 刪除。	After placing: drag to move, drag a corner to resize, drag the dot above to rotate, Del to delete.
建立 stick 資料夾	Create stick folder
在程式資料夾建立 stick 資料夾；之後在裡面建立主題資料夾，再放入 PNG 圖片。	Create a stick folder in the program folder; then create theme folders inside it and put PNG images in them.
開啟 stick 資料夾	Open stick folder
用檔案總管開啟貼圖資料夾，方便放入新的貼圖。	Open the sticker folder in File Explorer so you can add new stickers.
每個子資料夾是一個主題；檔名以 _ 或 cover 開頭的圖片當作封面，不會顯示。	Each subfolder is a theme; images whose names start with _ or cover are used as covers and not shown.
刪除貼圖	Delete sticker
刪除照片上選取的貼圖或文字。	Delete the sticker or text selected on the photo.
快捷鍵 Del。	Shortcut Del.
大小	Size
選取的貼圖或文字的大小（高度佔照片的百分比）。	Size of the selected sticker or text (height as a percentage of the photo).
也可以拖曳角落的控制點，或 Ctrl+滾輪。	You can also drag a corner handle, or use Ctrl+wheel.
旋轉	Rotation
選取的貼圖或文字的角度。	Angle of the selected sticker or text.
也可以拖曳上方的圓形把手（按住 Shift 每 15° 吸附），或 Shift+滾輪。	You can also drag the round handle above (hold Shift to snap every 15°), or use Shift+wheel.
100% 為完全不透明；越低越透明。	100% is fully opaque; lower is more transparent.
做浮水印可以用 30～50%。	For a watermark, 30–50% works well.
貼圖顏色	Sticker color
改變內建貼圖（愛心、星星等）的顏色。	Change the color of a built-in sticker (heart, star and so on).
圖片貼圖保留原本的顏色，不能改色。	Image stickers keep their original colors and can't be recolored.
先選取一張內建貼圖（圖片貼圖不能改色）。	Select a built-in sticker first (image stickers can't be recolored).
在貼圖下方加上陰影，讓它像浮在照片上。	Add a shadow under the sticker so it seems to float above the photo.
陰影的距離、方向、模糊在「文字」分頁的「陰影」組調整。	Shadow distance, direction and blur are set in the "Shadow" group on the Text tab.
字	T
刪除文字	Delete text
刪除照片上選取的文字。	Delete the text selected on the photo.
先在照片上點選一段文字。	Click a text on the photo first.
＋ 文字	+ Text
在照片中央加入一段文字，然後在下面的方框輸入內容。	Add a text in the center of the photo, then type its content in the box below.
拖曳移動、拖曳角落縮放、拖曳上方圓點旋轉；點樣式可以一次套用整組效果。	Drag to move, drag a corner to resize, drag the dot above to rotate; click a style to apply a whole set of effects at once.
日期戳記	Date stamp
用照片的拍攝日期（EXIF）做成傳統相機右下角的橘色日期。	Use the photo's capture date (EXIF) as the orange date in the lower right, like a classic camera.
照片沒有拍攝日期時改用檔案日期。	If the photo has no capture date, the file date is used.
插入資訊	Insert info
把照片的拍攝日期、時間、相機型號、檔名或 GPS 座標插入選取的文字；沒有選取時新增一段。	Insert the photo's capture date, time, camera model, file name or GPS coordinates into the selected text; adds a new text if none is selected.
文字內容	Text content
選取的文字要顯示的內容。	What the selected text shows.
按 Enter 換行；可以多行。	Press Enter for a new line; multiple lines are allowed.
字型	Font
文字的字型。「七段數字」是電子鐘般的數字，日期戳記就是用它。	Font of the text. "Seven-segment" gives digital-clock numbers; the date stamp uses it.
粗體	Bold
把文字加粗。	Make the text bold.
直排	Vertical
改成由上往下、由右往左的直式排列，適合中文標題與印章。	Arrange the text top to bottom, right to left; good for Chinese titles and seals.
多行文字的對齊方式：靠左、置中、靠右（直排時為靠上、置中、靠下）。	Alignment of multi-line text: left, center, right (top, center, bottom when vertical).
樣式	Style
一次套用整組字型、顏色與特效。	Apply a whole set of font, color and effects at once.
選取文字時套用到它；沒有選取時新增一段。套用後還可以再微調。	Applies to the selected text; adds a new text if none is selected. You can fine-tune afterwards.
排版	Layout
大小、旋轉、透明度、字距、行距與弧形文字。	Size, rotation, opacity, letter spacing, line spacing and arched text.
外框	Outline
文字的描邊，可以有兩層（例如可愛字的白框加彩框）。	Outline around the text, up to two layers (e.g. a white outline plus a colored one for cute text).
底色	Background
文字後面的底：圓角方塊、整列字幕條、壓暗照片或印章框。	A background behind the text: rounded box, full-width caption bar, darkened photo or seal frame.
文字或貼圖的陰影：顏色、距離、方向、模糊與不透明度。	Shadow of text or stickers: color, distance, direction, blur and opacity.
發光	Glow
文字或貼圖外圍的光暈，搭配深色照片最明顯。	A halo around text or stickers; most visible on dark photos.
立體	3D
往一個方向疊出厚度，做出立體字。	Stack up thickness in one direction for 3D text.
填色	Fill
文字的填色方式：單色、漸層、彩虹、圖片，或照片本身（鏤空字）。	How the text is filled: solid, gradient, rainbow, image, or the photo itself (knockout text).
字距	Tracking
字與字之間的距離；負值讓字靠緊一點。	Distance between characters; negative values pull them closer.
行距	Line spacing
多行文字的行與行距離（直排時為列距），100% 為標準。	Distance between lines of multi-line text (between columns when vertical); 100% is standard.
弧形	Arc
把文字排成弧形：往右向上拱（彩虹形），往左向下彎（微笑形），360° 為一整圈。	Set the text on an arc: right arches up (rainbow), left bends down (smile); 360° is a full circle.
多行會合成一行；直排時不使用。	Multiple lines are joined into one; not used for vertical text.
外框色	Outline color
第一層外框的顏色。	Color of the first outline.
按一下開啟調色盤。	Click to open the color picker.
外框粗細	Outline width
第一層外框的粗細，0 為不加外框。	Width of the first outline; 0 means no outline.
外層色	Outer color
第二層外框的顏色（在第一層外面）。	Color of the second outline (outside the first).
外層粗細	Outer width
在外框之外再加一圈，0 為不加。	Add another ring outside the outline; 0 means none.
例如：白色外框 + 粉紅外層 = 可愛字。	For example: white outline + pink outer = cute text.
底色樣式	Background style
圓角方塊：只墊在文字後面；字幕條：橫跨整張照片；壓暗照片：文字以外變暗；印章框：方框。	Rounded box: only behind the text; Caption bar: across the whole photo; Darken photo: everything except the text gets darker; Seal frame: a square frame.
「壓暗照片」配合填色「照片本身」就是鏤空字。	"Darken photo" together with fill "Photo itself" gives knockout text.
底色顏色	Background color
底色方塊、字幕條或印章框的顏色。	Color of the background box, caption bar or seal frame.
底色不透明度	Background opacity
底色的濃淡；字幕條常用 50～70%。	How solid the background is; caption bars often use 50–70%.
底色圓角	Background corners
底色方塊四個角的圓弧大小，0 為直角。	Corner radius of the background box; 0 is square.
底色留白	Background padding
文字與底色邊緣之間的空間。	Space between the text and the edge of the background.
陰影顏色	Shadow color
陰影的顏色；用亮色也可以做出光影效果。	Color of the shadow; a light color can make a lighting effect too.
開啟陰影	Shadow on
為選取的文字或貼圖加上陰影。	Add a shadow to the selected text or sticker.
陰影距離	Shadow distance
陰影離文字多遠；0 時陰影就在正下方（搭配模糊當作柔和的光暈）。	How far the shadow is from the text; at 0 it is right underneath (with blur, a soft halo).
陰影方向	Shadow direction
陰影往哪個方向：0° 往右、90° 往下、180° 往左、270° 往上。	Which way the shadow falls: 0° right, 90° down, 180° left, 270° up.
陰影模糊	Shadow blur
陰影邊緣的柔和程度；0 是清楚的硬陰影。	How soft the shadow edge is; 0 is a crisp hard shadow.
陰影不透明度	Shadow opacity
陰影的濃淡。	How dark the shadow is.
發光顏色	Glow color
光暈的顏色。	Color of the halo.
霓虹效果：亮色文字 + 同色系的發光。	Neon effect: bright text + a glow in the same color family.
發光大小	Glow size
光暈向外擴散的範圍，0 為不發光。	How far the halo spreads; 0 means no glow.
貼圖也可以發光。	Stickers can glow too.
側面色	Side color
立體字側面的顏色，通常比主色深。	Color of the sides of 3D text, usually darker than the main color.
立體厚度	3D depth
立體字的厚度，0 為平面。	Thickness of 3D text; 0 is flat.
立體方向	3D direction
厚度往哪個方向延伸：0° 往右、90° 往下。	Which way the thickness extends: 0° right, 90° down.
填色方式	Fill type
單色、漸層（主色到第二色）、彩虹、圖片（用一張圖填滿文字），或照片本身（鏤空）。	Solid, gradient (main color to second color), rainbow, image (fill the text with a picture), or the photo itself (knockout).
主色	Main color
文字的顏色；漸層時是起點的顏色。	Color of the text; for a gradient, the start color.
第二色	Color 2
漸層終點的顏色。	End color of the gradient.
只在填色方式為「漸層」時使用。	Used only when the fill type is "Gradient".
漸層方向	Gradient direction
漸層與彩虹的方向：0° 由左到右、90° 由上到下。	Direction of the gradient and rainbow: 0° left to right, 90° top to bottom.
填字圖片	Fill image
選一張圖片填滿文字（例如花紋、天空、木紋）。	Pick an image to fill the text (e.g. a pattern, sky, wood grain).
填色方式選「圖片」時使用。	Used when the fill type is "Image".
去	C
一般模型	General model
IS-Net 通用模型：寵物、動物、物品與人物都能找出主體。	IS-Net general model: finds the subject for pets, animals, objects and people.
照片有人臉時預設改用人像模型；畫面裡有其他顯眼物體時可能會一起保留。	When the photo has a face the portrait model is used by default; other prominent objects in the picture may be kept as well.
人像模型	Portrait model
U²-Net 人像模型：專門找人，身體輪廓與頭髮比較準，也比較快。	U²-Net portrait model: specialized for people; body outlines and hair are more accurate, and it's faster.
自動去背	Auto remove background
用上面選的模型找出主體，背景先換成透明（顯示為棋盤格）。	Find the subject with the model chosen above; the background becomes transparent first (shown as a checkerboard).
第一次使用要載入模型，需要幾秒鐘；結果在「存檔」時一起存進專案檔。	The model loads the first time, which takes a few seconds; the result is saved into the project file when you save.
正在計算去背，請稍候。	Removing the background, please wait.
塗抹被誤去掉的主體（例如頭髮、手指），把它補回來，顯示為綠色。	Paint over parts of the subject removed by mistake (hair, fingers) to bring them back; shown in green.
[ ] 調整筆刷大小；配合「檢查遮罩」看得最清楚。	[ ] change brush size; easiest to see with "Check mask".
塗抹沒去乾淨的背景，把它擦掉，顯示為紅色。	Paint over leftover background to erase it; shown in red.
[ ] 調整筆刷大小。	[ ] change brush size.
保留／擦除筆刷的半徑（像素）。	Radius of the restore and erase brushes (pixels).
清除修正	Clear corrections
移除所有保留／擦除筆觸與魔術棒點擊，回到 AI 自動去背的結果。	Remove all restore and erase strokes and magic wand clicks, back to the AI result.
在照片上點一下，去掉和點擊處顏色相近的區域（不必先自動去背，適合白底、藍天等單純背景）。	Click on the photo to remove areas similar in color to the click (no need to auto-remove first; good for plain backgrounds like white or blue sky).
快捷鍵 W；Alt＋點一下補回。可以連續點好幾次去掉不同顏色。	Shortcut W; Alt+click adds back. Click several times to remove different colors.
去除	Remove
魔術棒點一下會把相近顏色的區域去掉（變透明或換成背景）。	A magic wand click removes areas of similar color (they become transparent or get the new background).
按住 Alt 點一下則是補回。	Hold Alt and click to add back instead.
補回	Add back
魔術棒點一下會把相近顏色的區域加回主體（修正去太多的地方）。	A magic wand click adds areas of similar color back to the subject (fixes over-removal).
按住 Alt 點一下則是去除。	Hold Alt and click to remove instead.
相似程度	Tolerance
魔術棒選取的顏色範圍：0 只選完全相同的顏色，越大選得越廣，100 全選。一般照片約 15～35。	Color range of the magic wand: 0 selects only the exact color, larger selects more, 100 selects everything. About 15–35 for normal photos.
點過之後再拉，會直接調整最後一次點擊的範圍，不必重點。	Moving it after a click adjusts the range of the last click directly; no need to click again.
只選相連區域	Contiguous only
勾選：只選和點擊處連在一起的區域；不勾：整張照片所有相近的顏色（例如樹葉縫隙間的天空）。	Checked: only areas connected to the click; unchecked: every similar color in the whole photo (e.g. sky between leaves).
改變時也會套用到最後一次點擊。	Changing it also applies to the last click.
清除雜點	Clean specks
魔術棒選取後，自動補滿選取範圍裡的小破洞、去掉零星的小點（JPG 雜訊常造成這些斑點）。	After a magic wand selection, fill small holes in the selection and remove stray dots (often caused by JPG noise).
取消去背	Cancel removal
回到原本的照片。	Return to the original photo.
AI 算好的遮罩會保留，再按「自動去背」可以立刻套用。	The mask computed by AI is kept; click "Auto remove background" to apply it again instantly.
讓主體邊緣柔和，避免鋸齒與生硬的剪影感。	Soften the subject's edges to avoid jaggies and a harsh cut-out look.
換背景時羽化一點比較自然。	A little feathering looks more natural when replacing the background.
往左把邊緣往內縮，去掉殘留的背景邊；往右往外擴，找回被切掉的邊。	Left shrinks the edge inward to remove leftover background; right expands it to recover clipped edges.
換成	Replace with
背景要換成什麼：原背景、透明、純色、模糊（像大光圈的景深）或另一張圖片。	What the background becomes: original, transparent, solid color, blur (like wide-aperture depth of field) or another picture.
透明背景在匯出時存成 PNG。	A transparent background is saved as PNG when exporting.
背景顏色	Background color
背景選「純色」時的顏色，例如證件照的白色或藍色。	The color when the background is "Solid color", e.g. white or blue for ID photos.
背景選「模糊」時的模糊程度。	Blur amount when the background is "Blur".
背景圖片	Background image
選一張圖片當新背景，會自動放大填滿照片。	Pick a picture as the new background; it is scaled up to fill the photo.
合成結果	Result
顯示去背並換好背景的樣子。	Shows the cutout with the new background.
用紅色顯示被去掉的部分，方便找出漏掉或多去的地方，再用保留／擦除筆刷修正。	Show removed parts in red to find missed or over-removed areas, then fix them with the restore and erase brushes.
把去背後的主體裁切成透明 PNG，存進 stick 資料夾的主題裡，之後可以從「貼圖」分頁拖到其他照片上。	Crop the cutout subject into a transparent PNG and save it to a theme in the stick folder; you can then drag it from the Stickers tab onto other photos.
會詢問主題與名稱。	You will be asked for a theme and name.
選	Sel
像 PhotoImpact 的選取工具：矩形、橢圓、套索、魔術棒、貝茲；選取區可以加入、減去、交集、反轉與羽化。	Selection tools like PhotoImpact: rectangle, ellipse, lasso, magic wand, bezier; selections can be added, subtracted, intersected, inverted and feathered.
選好之後可以複製、剪下、貼成物件、只調整選取區、刪除、填色、描邊、裁切或當作去背範圍。	Once selected you can copy, cut, paste as object, adjust only the selection, delete, fill, stroke, crop or use it as the cutout area.
矩形選取	Rectangle select
在照片上拖曳拉出矩形選取區。	Drag on the photo to draw a rectangular selection.
按住 Ctrl 為正方形；點一下（不拖曳）取消選取。	Hold Ctrl for a square; click without dragging to deselect.
橢圓選取	Ellipse select
在照片上拖曳拉出橢圓選取區。	Drag on the photo to draw an elliptical selection.
按住 Ctrl 為正圓。	Hold Ctrl for a circle.
套索	Lasso
按住拖曳自由圈出範圍；或一下一下點出多邊形的頂點。	Drag to draw a freehand area, or click point by point for polygon vertices.
多邊形：按兩下、Enter 或點回第一點完成，Esc 取消。	Polygon: double-click, press Enter or click the first point to finish; Esc to cancel.
點一下選出和點擊處顏色相近的區域。	Click to select areas similar in color to the click.
用「相似程度」與「只選相連區域」控制範圍；只看照片本身，不看文字、貼圖與繪圖。	Control the range with "Tolerance" and "Contiguous only"; only the photo is considered, not text, stickers or drawings.
貝茲選取	Bezier select
點一下加錨點、按住拖曳拉出平滑曲線，圍出有弧度的範圍。	Click to add anchor points, drag to pull out smooth curves, enclosing a curved area.
按兩下、Enter 或點回第一點完成，Esc 取消。	Double-click, press Enter or click the first point to finish; Esc to cancel.
新增	New
新的選取區取代原本的。	The new selection replaces the old one.
加入	Add
新的範圍加進原本的選取區。	Add the new area to the existing selection.
也可以按住 Shift。	You can also hold Shift.
減去	Subtract
從原本的選取區扣掉新的範圍。	Subtract the new area from the existing selection.
也可以按住 Alt。	You can also hold Alt.
交集	Intersect
只留下原本與新範圍重疊的部分。	Keep only where the old and new areas overlap.
也可以按住 Shift＋Alt。	You can also hold Shift+Alt.
魔術棒只選和點擊處相連的區域；取消勾選會選整張照片中所有相近的顏色。	The magic wand selects only areas connected to the click; uncheck to select every similar color in the photo.
魔術棒選取的顏色範圍：越大選到越多相近的顏色。	Color range of the magic wand: larger selects more similar colors.
改了只影響下一次點擊。	Changes affect only the next click.
讓選取區的邊緣變柔和（100 = 照片短邊的 5%）。	Soften the selection edge (100 = 5% of the photo's short side).
影響之後的複製、填色、刪除與局部調整。	Affects later copy, fill, delete and local adjustments.
先選取一個範圍。	Make a selection first.
選取整張照片。	Select the whole photo.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+A。	Shortcut Ctrl+A.
取消選取	Deselect
清除選取區。	Clear the selection.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+D；Esc 也可以。	Shortcut Ctrl+D; Esc works too.
目前沒有選取區。	There is no selection.
反轉	Invert
選取區以外的部分變成選取區。	Everything outside the selection becomes the selection.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+Shift+I。	Shortcut Ctrl+Shift+I.
複製	Copy
把選取區（看到的畫面，含文字、貼圖、繪圖）複製到剪貼簿，保留透明。	Copy the selection (what you see, including text, stickers and drawings) to the clipboard, keeping transparency.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+C；沒有選取區時複製整張。	Shortcut Ctrl+C; copies the whole picture when there is no selection.
剪下	Cut
把選取區的照片複製到剪貼簿，原處變透明。	Copy the selected part of the photo to the clipboard and make it transparent in place.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+X；可以再「貼成物件」貼回去移動。	Shortcut Ctrl+X; then "Paste as object" to paste it back and move it.
貼成物件	Paste as object
把剪貼簿的圖片貼到照片上，成為可以拖曳、縮放、旋轉的物件。	Paste the clipboard image onto the photo as an object you can drag, resize and rotate.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+Alt+V；剛複製的會放回原位。	Shortcut Ctrl+Alt+V; something just copied goes back to its original position.
複製成物件	Copy as object
把選取區的照片複製成一個物件，放在原位上面，拖曳就能移開，原本的照片不變。	Copy the selected part of the photo into an object on top of the original spot; drag to move it away. The photo itself is unchanged.
只調整選取區	Adjust selection only
新增一個只作用在選取區的局部調整（曝光、對比、飽和度、色溫），並切到「局部」分頁。	Add a local adjustment (exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature) that affects only the selection, and switch to the Local tab.
刪除（透明）	Delete
選取區變透明（用去背做，原圖不變）。	Make the selection transparent (done with the cutout; the original is unchanged).
快捷鍵 Del；在「去背」分頁可以把透明處換成顏色或其他背景。	Shortcut Del; on the Cutout tab you can replace transparent areas with a color or another background.
填滿	Fill
把選取範圍填滿顏色、漸層、材質，或用內容感知（附近的照片）補滿。	Fill the selection with a color, gradient or texture, or content-aware (with nearby parts of the photo).
可以填在新圖層或選取的點陣圖層（保留透明度）；有不透明度與混合模式。	Fill into a new layer or the selected raster layer (preserving transparency), with opacity and blend mode.
填滿：顏色	Fill: color
整個選取範圍填一個顏色；點色塊選顏色（材質也用這個顏色）。	Fill the whole selection with one color; click the swatch to pick it (textures use this color too).
填滿：漸層	Fill: gradient
依選取範圍的外框畫漸層：類型、方向（線性從一邊到對邊，放射類從中心往那一邊），顏色從「顏色」到「第二色」。	Draw a gradient within the selection's bounds: type and direction (linear goes from one side to the other, radial types go from the center toward that side), from "Color" to "Second color".
四色漸層用繪圖分頁漸層工具設定的四個角的顏色。	Four-color gradients use the four corner colors set with the gradient tool on the Draw tab.
填滿：材質	Fill: texture
用紋理筆的 64 種材質填滿（木紋、石頭、布料、金屬…），可調色的材質用上面的顏色。	Fill with one of the 64 textures of the texture brush (wood, stone, fabric, metal…); tintable textures use the color above.
填滿：內容感知	Fill: content-aware
從附近找紋理相近的地方把選取範圍補滿，用來移除雜物、電線、路人；選取範圍比雜物稍大一點效果最好。	Fill the selection with similar texture found nearby to remove clutter, wires or passers-by; a selection slightly bigger than the object works best.
填在新圖層，照片本身不變；不滿意按 Ctrl+Z，換個選取範圍再試。	Fills into a new layer and the photo is unchanged; if you don't like it, press Ctrl+Z and try a different selection.
不透明度	Opacity
填滿的不透明度。	Opacity of the fill.
混合模式	Blend mode
填滿和下面的顏色怎麼混合（色彩增值、濾色、覆蓋…），同圖層的混合模式。	How the fill blends with the colors below (multiply, screen, overlay…); the same as the layer blend mode.
填在	Fill into
新圖層（之後可以單獨調整、刪除），或繪圖分頁選取的點陣圖層。	A new layer (adjust or delete it separately later), or the raster layer selected on the Draw tab.
保留透明度	Preserve transparency
只改圖層上已經有內容的地方的顏色，透明的地方不會被填上（同 Photoshop）。	Only recolor where the layer already has content; transparent areas are not filled (as in Photoshop).
只有填在既有的點陣圖層時才能用。	Available only when filling an existing raster layer.
漸層的終點顏色（漸層從「顏色」到「第二色」）。	End color of the gradient (from "Color" to "Second color").
名稱	Name
填滿圖層的名稱；空白時依內容自動命名。	Name of the fill layer; named automatically from its content when empty.
描邊	Stroke
新增一個點陣圖層，沿著選取區的邊畫線；可以選顏色、寬度與內側／置中／外側。	Add a raster layer with a line drawn along the selection edge; choose color, width and inside / center / outside.
裁切到選取區	Crop to selection
把照片裁到選取區的外接矩形。	Crop the photo to the bounding rectangle of the selection.
按復原可以還原。	Undo restores it.
當作去背範圍	Use as cutout area
只保留選取區，其他部分變透明；可以和 AI 去背、魔術棒、修正筆刷一起用。	Keep only the selection and make the rest transparent; works together with AI cutout, magic wand and correction brushes.
到「去背」分頁換背景。	Replace the background on the Cutout tab.
圖	Lyr
圖層	Layers
文字、貼圖與繪圖圖層的總清單：任意調整上下順序、設定混合模式與不透明度、顯示或隱藏、合併圖層。	The list of all text, sticker and drawing layers: reorder freely, set blend mode and opacity, show or hide, merge layers.
照片本身與調色不是圖層，永遠在最底下；按兩下圖層可以跳到它的分頁編輯。	The photo itself and its adjustments are not a layer and always stay at the bottom; double-click a layer to jump to its tab for editing.
圖層清單	Layer list
上面的圖層蓋住下面的。點選以選取；點眼睛顯示或隱藏，點鎖頭鎖定繪圖圖層。	Upper layers cover lower ones. Click to select; click the eye to show or hide, click the lock to lock a drawing layer.
按兩下跳到該圖層的分頁（文字、裝飾、貼圖或繪圖）編輯。	Double-click to jump to that layer's tab (Text, Decorate, Stickers or Draw) to edit it.
這個圖層和下面所有東西（含照片）怎麼混合，和 Photoshop 的混合模式相同。	How this layer blends with everything below (including the photo), the same as Photoshop blend modes.
色彩增值讓白色變透明、適合線稿；濾色讓黑色變透明、適合光線特效；覆蓋與柔光增加對比。	Multiply makes white transparent, good for line art; Screen makes black transparent, good for light effects; Overlay and Soft Light add contrast.
先在清單選一個圖層。	Select a layer in the list first.
移到最上	To top
把選取的圖層移到最上面。	Move the selected layer to the top.
上移	Move up
把選取的圖層往上移一層。	Move the selected layer up one level.
下移	Move down
把選取的圖層往下移一層。	Move the selected layer down one level.
移到最下	To bottom
把選取的圖層移到最下面（照片正上方）。	Move the selected layer to the bottom (right above the photo).
合併向下	Merge down
把選取的圖層和正下方的圖層合併成一個點陣圖層，保留各自的混合模式與不透明度。	Merge the selected layer with the layer directly below into one raster layer, keeping each one's blend mode and opacity.
合併後文字、形狀不能再個別修改，但可以整體移動、直接繪製或擦除；放大匯出一樣清楚。按復原可以還原。	After merging, text and shapes can no longer be edited individually, but you can move the whole layer, paint on it or erase; enlarged exports stay sharp. Undo restores it.
下層是半透明、上層又用了混合模式時，合併後顏色可能略有不同（Photoshop 也是這樣）。	When the lower layer is semi-transparent and the upper layer uses a blend mode, colors may differ slightly after merging (Photoshop does the same).
先選一個下面還有圖層的圖層。	Select a layer that has another layer below it.
合併可見	Merge all
把所有顯示中的圖層合併成一個點陣圖層；隱藏的圖層保留不動。	Merge all visible layers into one raster layer; hidden layers are left as they are.
至少要有兩個圖層。	At least two layers are needed.
編輯	Edit
跳到這個圖層的分頁編輯（也可以在清單上按兩下）。	Jump to this layer's tab to edit it (or double-click it in the list).
刪除	Delete
刪除選取的圖層（多選時全部）。	Delete the selected layer (all of them when several are selected).
可以按復原救回來。	Undo brings it back.
選取圖層的整體不透明度。	Overall opacity of the selected layer.
繪	Dr
繪圖	Draw
用 18 種工具與 16 種筆刷在照片上畫畫：自由繪製、形狀、箭頭、星形、圖說文字。每個形狀是一個圖層，可以隨時再修改。	Draw on the photo with 18 tools and 16 brushes: freehand, shapes, arrows, stars, callouts. Each shape is a layer you can change at any time.
繪圖不會改到原始照片，存在編輯檔裡。	Drawing never changes the original photo; it is stored in the edit file.
取消上一個動作（畫一筆、拖一次控制點、改一次顏色都各算一步）。	Undo the last action (each stroke, handle drag or color change counts as one step).
快捷鍵 Ctrl+Z。	Shortcut Ctrl+Z.
重做	Redo
把剛剛復原的動作做回來。	Redo the action you just undid.
快捷鍵 Ctrl+Y。	Shortcut Ctrl+Y.
完成	Done
結束目前的動作：完成多邊形、結束圖說文字輸入，或取消選取。	Finish the current action: complete a polygon, end callout text entry, or deselect.
快捷鍵 Enter。	Shortcut Enter.
全螢幕繪圖	Full-screen drawing
畫布填滿整個螢幕（保留 Windows 工作列），收起選單、面板與工具列，適合用繪圖板畫圖；工具用 F9 快速面板、F10 輪盤。	The canvas fills the whole screen (keeping the Windows taskbar) and menus, panels and toolbars are hidden; great for drawing with a tablet. Use the F9 quick panel and the F10 wheel for tools.
快捷鍵 F11；Esc、F11 或右上角按鈕離開。也可以點輪盤中間。	Shortcut F11; leave with Esc, F11 or the button at the top right. You can also click the center of the wheel.
點選照片上的圖形，拖曳移動；選取後可縮放、旋轉、調整形狀。點陣圖層要點在畫過的線上才選得到（虛線框內的空白不算）。拖曳空白處框選、Shift＋點選加選或取消；多選時一起移動、縮放、旋轉、改顏色。	Click shapes on the photo and drag to move them; once selected you can resize, rotate and reshape. A raster layer is selected only by clicking on painted lines (empty space in its dashed box doesn't count). Drag on empty space to marquee-select; Shift+click to add or remove; multiple selections move, resize, rotate and recolor together.
用其他繪圖工具時按住 Ctrl 也能暫時點選、拖曳（放開回到原工具）；其他工具點下去一律是畫，不會誤拖圖層。藍色方塊縮放、上方圓點旋轉、黃點調整形狀；方向鍵微調，Del 刪除。	With other drawing tools, hold Ctrl to click and drag temporarily (release to return to the tool); clicking with other tools always draws and never drags a layer by accident. Blue squares resize, the dot above rotates, yellow dots reshape; arrow keys nudge, Del deletes.
自由繪製（向量）	Freehand (vector)
用目前的筆刷畫線，每一筆都保留成向量，之後可以再移動、縮放、改顏色與筆刷。	Draw lines with the current brush; each stroke stays vector, so you can move, resize, recolor and change its brush later.
支援繪圖板筆壓；滑鼠畫毛筆、墨水時依速度改變粗細。換顏色或筆刷再畫會成為新的圖層。	Supports tablet pressure; with a mouse, calligraphy brush and ink vary in width with speed. Changing color or brush and drawing again creates a new layer.
直線	Line
拖曳畫出直線。	Drag to draw a straight line.
按住 Shift 以 45° 為單位；畫好後可拖曳兩端。	Hold Shift for 45° steps; drag either end afterwards.
貝茲曲線	Bezier curve
拖曳畫出一條曲線，再拖曳兩個黃色控制點調整彎曲。	Drag to draw a curve, then drag the two yellow control points to bend it.
藍色方塊是兩端，可以再拖曳。	The blue squares are the ends and can be dragged too.
矩形	Rectangle
拖曳畫出矩形。	Drag to draw a rectangle.
按住 Shift 為正方形；畫好後可縮放、旋轉。	Hold Shift for a square; resize and rotate afterwards.
圓角矩形	Rounded rectangle
拖曳畫出圓角矩形，拖曳黃點調整圓角大小。	Drag to draw a rounded rectangle; drag the yellow dot to change the corner size.
按住 Shift 為正方形。	Hold Shift for a square.
橢圓	Ellipse
拖曳畫出橢圓。	Drag to draw an ellipse.
按住 Shift 為正圓。	Hold Shift for a circle.
多邊形	Polygon
逐點點出多邊形的頂點。	Click the polygon's vertices one by one.
點回第一點、按兩下或 Enter 完成，Esc 取消；畫好後可拖曳每個頂點。	Click the first point, double-click or press Enter to finish, Esc to cancel; drag each vertex afterwards.
箭頭	Arrow
拖曳畫出箭頭，拖曳黃點調整箭頭長度與箭身粗細。	Drag to draw an arrow; drag the yellow dots to change the head length and shaft width.
用上方圓點旋轉成任何方向。	Rotate it to any direction with the dot above.
愛心	Heart
拖曳畫出愛心。	Drag to draw a heart.
按住 Shift 保持比例；點一下就會放一個預設大小的愛心。	Hold Shift to keep proportions; a single click places a heart of default size.
四角星形	4-point star
拖曳畫出四角星，拖曳黃點調整星形的胖瘦。	Drag to draw a 4-point star; drag the yellow dot to make it fatter or thinner.
五角星形	5-point star
拖曳畫出五角星，拖曳黃點調整星形的胖瘦。	Drag to draw a 5-point star; drag the yellow dot to make it fatter or thinner.
六角星形	6-point star
拖曳畫出六角星，拖曳黃點調整星形的胖瘦。	Drag to draw a 6-point star; drag the yellow dot to make it fatter or thinner.
圓角矩形圖說	Rounded rectangle callout
有指示尖角的圓角方框，可以在裡面輸入文字。	A rounded box with a pointer; you can type text inside.
拖曳黃點改變指向與圓角，按兩下輸入文字。	Drag the yellow dots to change the pointer and corners; double-click to type text.
橢圓圖說	Oval callout
有指示尖角的橢圓對話框。	An oval speech bubble with a pointer.
拖曳黃點改變指向，按兩下輸入文字。	Drag the yellow dot to change the pointer; double-click to type text.
雲朵圖說	Cloud callout
雲朵形狀的「心裡想」對話框，指示是一串小泡泡。	A cloud-shaped "thinking" bubble whose pointer is a trail of small bubbles.
拖曳黃點改變泡泡的方向，按兩下輸入文字。	Drag the yellow dot to change the direction of the bubbles; double-click to type text.
氣泡圖說	Bubble callout
漫畫風格的圓胖對話泡泡，尾巴是彎的。	A chubby comic-style speech bubble with a curved tail.
吶喊框	Shout box
尖刺爆炸狀的吶喊框，適合大叫、驚訝的台詞。	A spiky explosion-shaped shout box for yelling or surprised lines.
拖曳黃點把其中一根尖刺拉成指示，按兩下輸入文字。	Drag the yellow dot to pull one spike out as a pointer; double-click to type text.
閃電	Lightning
拖曳畫出閃電。	Drag to draw a lightning bolt.
可以縮放、旋轉；搭配黃色填色與「發光」般的特效筆。	Can be resized and rotated; pair it with a yellow fill and a glow-like effect brush.
漸層	Gradient
在照片上拖一條線畫出漸層：起點是線條色、終點是填色（Shift 鎖 45°）。	Drag a line on the photo to draw a gradient: it starts with the line color and ends with the fill color (Shift locks to 45°).
畫在選取的點陣圖層，沒有選圖層時自動新增；有選取範圍（選取分頁）時只畫在範圍裡。類型與顏色在畫布上方。	Draws on the selected raster layer, or adds one when no layer is selected; with a selection (Selection tab) it draws only inside it. Type and colors are above the canvas.
漸層類型	Gradient type
線性（沿著線）、放射（從起點往外一圈圈）、角度（繞著起點轉一圈）、反射（起點往兩邊對稱）、菱形，	Linear (along the line), radial (rings out from the start), angle (one turn around the start), reflected (symmetric on both sides of the start), diamond,
或四色（拖曳的範圍當方框，四個角各一個顏色，像 PhotoImpact 的四色漸層）。	or four-color (the dragged area is a box with a color at each corner, like PhotoImpact's four-color gradient).
漸層顏色	Gradient colors
線條色 → 填色、線條色 → 透明（疊在照片上做天空、暗角），或彩虹。	Line color → fill color, line color → transparent (over the photo for skies and vignettes), or rainbow.
四色漸層的角	Four-color corners
四色漸層四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）的顏色，點一下選顏色。	Colors of the four corners (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right) of the four-color gradient; click to pick a color.
起點和終點的顏色對調。	Swap the start and end colors.
防色階	Dither
加一點看不出來的雜點，大片的平滑漸層不會出現一條條的色階。	Add a little invisible noise so large smooth gradients don't show banding.
油漆桶	Paint bucket
點一下把顏色相近的區域填滿：顏色用線條色、質感跟著目前筆刷（紋理筆填材質、水彩有水彩邊）。	Click to fill an area of similar color: the color is the line color and the look follows the current brush (texture brush fills texture, watercolor has watercolor edges).
填在選取的點陣圖層，沒有選圖層時自動新增；選項在畫布上方。漫畫上色：上色圖層放在線稿下面，取樣「所有圖層」，線稿有缺口就調高「補缺口」。	Fills the selected raster layer, or adds one when no layer is selected; options are above the canvas. Coloring comics: put the color layer under the line art, sample "All layers", and raise "Close gaps" if the line art has gaps.
容許度	Tolerance
和點下去的顏色差多少以內算同一區（0..255）：越大填得越多。	How different from the clicked color still counts as the same area (0..255): larger fills more.
預設 32；照片上的漸層要調高。	Default 32; raise it for gradients in photos.
相鄰	Contiguous
只填和點下去的地方相連的區域；取消時整張圖所有相近的顏色都填。	Fill only the area connected to the click; when off, every similar color in the picture is filled.
取樣	Sample
判斷顏色時看哪裡：「所有圖層」看照片與上下所有圖層（線稿在別的圖層也能填），「目前圖層」只看選取的圖層。	Where colors are judged: "All layers" looks at the photo and every layer (so you can fill when the line art is on another layer); "Current layer" looks only at the selected layer.
補缺口	Close gaps
線稿上有小缺口時當作封閉，不會漏到外面（0 = 不封閉；數字越大能補的缺口越寬）。	Treat small gaps in line art as closed so the fill doesn't leak (0 = don't close; larger closes wider gaps).
單位是照片高度的千分之一；填色仍會貼齊線稿。點在比缺口還窄的縫裡時不封閉。	The unit is a thousandth of the photo height; the fill still snaps to the line art. Not closed when you click in a slit narrower than the gap.
擴張	Expand
填色往外多長一點，蓋住線稿邊緣半透明的像素，不會留白邊（單位：照片高度的千分之一）。	Grow the fill outward a little to cover semi-transparent pixels at the line art edge, so no white rim is left (unit: a thousandth of the photo height).
柔邊	Soft edge
填色的邊緣消除鋸齒。	Smooth the jagged edges of the fill.
填入	Fill with
「目前筆刷」用線條色與筆刷質感；「原照片」填回照片（與下面圖層）的顏色，把蓋掉的地方補回來。	"Current brush" uses the line color and brush look; "Original photo" fills with the colors of the photo (and layers below), restoring covered areas.
筆刷（直接繪製）	Brush (paint directly)
像 Photoshop 的筆刷：直接畫在目前選取的點陣圖層上，畫完就是像素。	Like Photoshop's brush: paints directly on the selected raster layer, and the result is pixels.
沒有選圖層時自動新增點陣圖層；選到向量圖層時會問要點陣化還是新增點陣圖層。B 畫筆、E 橡皮擦；選取工具可以整層移動。	Adds a raster layer when none is selected; on a vector layer you are asked whether to rasterize it or add a raster layer. B brush, E eraser; the select tool moves the whole layer.
用目前的筆刷形狀擦掉點陣圖層上畫過的地方（粗細、柔邊、不透明度都有效）。	Erase painted areas of a raster layer with the current brush shape (size, softness and opacity all apply).
快捷鍵 E；按 B 換回畫筆。不必切換：按住滑鼠右鍵拖曳，或把繪圖筆倒過來用橡皮擦端，就是暫時的橡皮擦（同 Painter）。只能擦點陣圖層。	Shortcut E; press B to return to the brush. No need to switch: drag with the right mouse button, or flip your pen to use its eraser end, for a temporary eraser (as in Painter). Works only on raster layers.
擦法	Erase mode
擦掉：擦成透明。漂白：越擦越淡、往白色靠。加深：越擦越暗（同 Painter 的 Bleach、Darkener）。	Erase: erase to transparent. Bleach: lighter toward white the more you rub. Darken: darker the more you rub (like Painter's Bleach and Darkener).
漂白、加深不改透明度，只改點陣圖層上畫過的地方；按鈕、右鍵、筆的橡皮擦端都用這個擦法。	Bleach and darken don't change transparency; they only affect painted areas of a raster layer. The button, right-click and the pen's eraser end all use this mode.
硬筆	Hard brush
邊緣清楚的實心筆，適合線稿、漫畫、填色。	A solid brush with crisp edges, good for line art, comics and coloring.
繪圖板筆壓會讓線條粗細變化。	Tablet pressure varies the line width.
軟筆	Soft brush
邊緣柔和的圓筆，適合陰影、霧化、光暈。	A round brush with soft edges, good for shading, haze and glows.
鉛筆	Pencil
有紙張顆粒感的細線，適合素描、草稿。	Thin lines with paper grain, good for sketches and drafts.
粗細調小一點最像鉛筆。	A small size looks most like a pencil.
炭筆	Charcoal
粗糙乾燥的筆觸，重複塗會越來越深，適合素描與暗部。	Rough, dry strokes that get darker as you go over them; good for sketching and shadows.
粉筆	Chalk
顆粒明顯、邊緣破碎，像黑板上的粉筆或粉彩。	Visible grain and broken edges, like chalk on a blackboard or pastel.
蠟筆	Crayon
粗糙的蠟質感，紙紋處會露白，適合插畫與童趣風。	A rough waxy texture that leaves white in the paper grain; good for illustrations and a childlike style.
水彩	Watercolor
半透明、邊緣顏料較濃、帶紙張紋理，疊色會越來越深。	Semi-transparent, with denser pigment at the edges and paper texture; overlapping strokes get darker.
流量調低更透明。	Lower flow is more transparent.
厚重的筆觸，看得到筆毛痕跡與厚塗的光影。	Thick strokes with visible bristle marks and impasto highlights.
壓克力	Acrylic
顏料感較實的筆觸，筆痕明顯但比油畫平整。	Solid-looking paint with clear brush marks, but flatter than oil.
墨水	Ink
黑白漫畫的墨線：收筆時變細，粗細隨筆壓（或滑鼠速度）變化。	Black-and-white comic ink lines: they taper at the end and vary in width with pressure (or mouse speed).
毛筆	Calligraphy
粗細變化大、筆畫尾端會飛白，適合書法與國畫。	Large width variation with dry-brush streaks at the end; good for calligraphy and Chinese painting.
用滑鼠時畫慢一點線條較粗，畫快較細。	With a mouse, slower strokes are thicker and faster ones thinner.
麥克筆	Marker
斜切筆頭、平滑半透明，重疊的地方顏色會加深。	A chisel tip, smooth and semi-transparent; overlaps get darker.
噴槍	Airbrush
非常柔和的噴霧，適合漸層、皮膚、光影。	A very soft spray, good for gradients, skin and lighting.
來回噴會越來越濃。	Spraying back and forth builds up density.
乾刷	Dry brush
顏料不足的刷痕，容易產生刮擦感與斷續的筆毛紋路。	Brush marks with little paint, giving scratchy, broken bristle textures.
紋理筆	Texture brush
畫出 64 種材質紋理，分六類：自然（石頭、大理石、沙漠…）、植物（木紋、樹葉、苔蘚…）、建築（磚牆、水泥、鐵鏽…）、手工（紙張、布料、皮革…）、金屬（鋼、銅、金、水銀…）、生物（豹紋、蛇皮、魚鱗…）。	Paints 64 material textures in six groups: Nature (stone, marble, desert…), Plants (wood, leaves, moss…), Building (brick, concrete, rust…), Craft (paper, fabric, leather…), Metal (steel, copper, gold, mercury…), Creatures (leopard, snakeskin, fish scales…).
在下方「效果」先選分類再選材質；用來填滿形狀效果最好。布料、磁磚等可調色的材質用線條色。	Under "Effect" below, pick a group and then a texture; works best for filling shapes. Tintable textures such as fabric and tiles use the line color.
特效筆	Effect brush
沿著筆畫產生 68 種特效，分七類：光／能量、火／煙／爆炸、液體／自然、動態效果、魔法／科幻、漫畫效果、動畫／特攝／電影（傳奇哥吉拉-原子吐息：從起點往終點越噴越粗；傳奇基多拉-引力光線：金色鋸齒閃電光束；1995紅蓮哥吉拉-放射熱線：紅橘光束纏著閃電般的螺旋，越噴越粗；奧特曼-斯派修姆光線：手掌星芒＋藍白平行光條；奧特曼-哉佩利敖光線：從手部散開的粗金色光柱；奧特曼-M87光線：彩虹色掃描線組成的寬光帶）。	Creates 68 effects along the stroke in seven groups: Light/Energy, Fire/Smoke/Explosion, Liquid/Nature, Motion, Magic/Sci-fi, Comic effects, Anime/Tokusatsu/Film (Legendary Godzilla atomic breath: grows thicker from start to end; Legendary Ghidorah gravity beams: golden jagged lightning beams; 1995 Burning Godzilla spiral ray: a red-orange beam wrapped in a lightning-like spiral, growing thicker; Ultraman Specium Ray: a star burst at the hand + blue-white parallel beams; Ultraman Zeperion Ray: a thick golden beam spreading from the hands; Ultraman M87 Ray: a wide band of rainbow scan lines).
在下方「效果」先選分類再選特效；集中線、放射線、衝擊波、黑洞、HUD 以每一筆的中心為準。	Under "Effect" below, pick a group and then an effect; speed lines, radial lines, shock waves, black holes and HUD use the center of each stroke.
效果分類	Effect group
特效筆或紋理筆的分類；換分類時會套用該類的第一項。	Group of the effect brush or texture brush; changing the group applies its first item.
先選「特效筆」或「紋理筆」。	Choose "Effect brush" or "Texture brush" first.
要畫的特效或材質；選了之後線條色會換成建議的顏色，可以再自己改。	The effect or texture to paint; choosing one changes the line color to a suggested color, which you can change.
線條色	Line color
筆畫與形狀外框的顏色。點了打開浮動的選色視窗，改顏色立即套用，可以一直開著邊畫邊換。	Color of strokes and shape outlines. Click to open a floating color window; changes apply immediately, and you can keep it open while drawing.
選取圖形時改它；沒有選取時是之後要畫的顏色。畫布上按住 Alt 點一下吸色（Alt＋Shift 吸成填色；仿製筆的 Alt 是設定來源）。	Changes the selected shape; with nothing selected, it is the color for the next drawing. On the canvas, Alt+click picks a color (Alt+Shift picks the fill color; for the clone brush Alt sets the source).
封閉形狀（矩形、圓形、星形、圖說…）裡面的顏色。點了打開選色視窗並切到「填色」。	Color inside closed shapes (rectangles, circles, stars, callouts…). Click to open the color window on "Fill".
選了顏色會自動打開「填色」。	Picking a color turns "Fill" on automatically.
文字色	Text color
圖說文字的顏色。點了打開選色視窗並切到「文字」。	Color of callout text. Click to open the color window on "Text".
形狀要不要畫外框線。	Whether shapes get an outline.
封閉形狀裡面要不要填色。	Whether closed shapes are filled.
圖說預設會填色。	Callouts are filled by default.
在圖形右下方加上柔和的陰影。	Add a soft shadow to the lower right of the shape.
粗細	Width
線條的粗細（以照片高度為準，放大縮小照片都一樣）。	Line width (relative to the photo height, so it stays the same when zooming).
選取自由繪製圖層時用「選取」工具才會改到已畫的筆畫。	For a selected freehand layer, existing strokes change only with the Select tool.
邊緣淡化：越大邊緣越柔和。	Edge fade: larger is softer.
整個圖層的透明度。	Transparency of the whole layer.
流量	Flow
顏料濃度：水彩、噴槍、炭筆越低越淡，其他筆刷會變得半透明。	Paint density: watercolor, airbrush and charcoal get paler when lower; other brushes become semi-transparent.
混色筆	Blender
像濕顏料：帶著線條色畫，同時沾起照片與下面圖層的顏色混在一起，越畫越混。	Like wet paint: paints with the line color while picking up the colors of the photo and layers below and mixing them in, more and more as you paint.
只能直接繪製在點陣圖層上；「進階」的濕度越高沾越多、混越多，流量越高補顏料越快。	Paints only directly on raster layers; higher "Advanced" wetness picks up and mixes more, higher flow replenishes paint faster.
塗抹筆	Smudge
不加顏色，把照片與下面圖層的顏色沿著筆畫推開、抹勻（像用手指抹）。	Adds no color; pushes and smooths the colors of the photo and layers below along the stroke (like smudging with a finger).
只能直接繪製在點陣圖層上；濕度越高抹得越長；原圖不會被改到，抹的結果畫在點陣圖層。	Paints only directly on raster layers; higher wetness smudges farther; the original is untouched and the smudge goes onto the raster layer.
粒子筆	Particle brush
沿筆畫噴出細絲：重力（往外噴再落下，像毛髮、噴泉）、流動（順著氣流彎曲，像煙絲、髮絲）、彈簧（被筆尖拉著甩出一圈圈的線）。	Sprays fine strands along the stroke: Gravity (sprays out and falls, like hair or fountains), Flow (curves with the air, like smoke or hair), Spring (strands flung out in loops behind the tip).
在「效果」選粒子種類；色相、明暗變化會讓每根細絲顏色不同。	Choose the particle type under "Effect"; hue and value jitter give each strand a different color.
仿製筆	Clone brush
把照片的另一處畫過來：先按住 Alt 點一下設定來源，再到要畫的地方拖曳。	Paint another part of the photo here: Alt+click first to set the source, then drag where you want to paint.
