對齊模式：之後每一筆都和來源保持同樣的距離，重新 Alt 點選才換來源。只能直接繪製在點陣圖層上。	Aligned mode: every later stroke keeps the same offset from the source; Alt+click again to change the source. Paints only directly on raster layers.
貼圖噴槍	Sticker hose
沿著筆畫噴灑貼圖，每張隨機挑選、旋轉、大小不同。	Sprays stickers along the stroke, each randomly chosen, rotated and sized.
在「效果」選貼圖主題（內建或貼圖資料夾）；粗細決定貼圖大小，「進階」的間距、散佈、大小變化也有效。	Choose the sticker theme (built-in or the sticker folder) under "Effect"; width sets the sticker size, and "Advanced" spacing, scatter and size jitter apply too.
進階	Advanced
展開更多筆刷設定：間距、散佈、大小與顏色變化、筆壓濃淡、混色濕度、繪圖筆的傾斜與旋轉、對稱繪圖。	Show more brush settings: spacing, scatter, size and color jitter, pressure opacity, blender wetness, pen tilt and rotation, symmetry painting.
設定只影響之後畫的筆畫；選取工具選到圖層時改的是那個圖層。	Settings affect only strokes drawn afterwards; when the Select tool has a layer selected, they change that layer.
間距	Spacing
筆印之間的距離（筆寬的 %）。「自動」用筆刷的預設；調大會變成一顆顆的點。	Distance between dabs (% of brush width). "Auto" uses the brush default; larger turns the stroke into separate dots.
散佈	Scatter
每個筆印隨機往兩側偏移，畫出一團散開的點。	Each dab is randomly offset to the sides, painting a spread of dots.
大小變化	Size jitter
每個筆印隨機變大變小。	Each dab randomly gets bigger or smaller.
色相變化	Hue jitter
每個筆印（筆毛、粒子）的顏色隨機往旁邊的色相偏，100 = 什麼顏色都有。	The color of each dab (bristle, particle) shifts randomly to nearby hues; 100 = any color.
明暗變化	Value jitter
每個筆印隨機變亮或變暗，畫起來有層次。	Each dab is randomly lighter or darker, adding depth.
筆壓濃淡	Pressure opacity
用繪圖筆時，輕輕畫比較淡、用力畫比較濃（筆壓本來只影響粗細）。	With a pen, light strokes are paler and hard strokes denser (pressure otherwise affects only width).
濕度	Wetness
混色筆、塗抹筆：越濕沾起越多畫布上的顏色，抹得越長、混得越多。	Blender and smudge: wetter picks up more color from the canvas, smudging farther and mixing more.
筆傾斜改變筆尖	Pen tilt changes the tip
繪圖筆斜著拿時像用筆側塗：筆觸變寬變扁，扁的方向跟著筆傾斜的方向；	Holding the pen at an angle is like painting with its side: strokes get wider and flatter, flattened in the tilt direction;
鉛筆、炭筆、粉筆、蠟筆越斜越淡、越只碰到紙紋凸起，油畫、壓克力越斜顏料越少、筆毛越容易斷開（乾擦）。	pencil, charcoal, chalk and crayon get paler and touch only the grain peaks as you tilt; oil and acrylic carry less paint and the bristles break up more (dry scumbling).
需要支援傾斜的繪圖筆；滑鼠沒有作用。	Needs a pen that supports tilt; no effect with a mouse.
穩定器	Stabilizer
畫長弧線時去掉手抖：筆尖像被一條線拖著走，游標在線長範圍內的抖動不會畫出來，放開時補到放開的位置。	Removes hand jitter in long curves: the tip is pulled along by a string, jitter within the string length isn't drawn, and the stroke catches up to where you release.
數值越大線越長、線條越順，但筆尖會落後游標。自由繪製與直接繪製共用，記在設定裡（不屬於圖層）。	Larger values mean a longer string and smoother lines, but the tip lags behind the cursor. Shared by freehand and direct painting, and stored in settings (not in the layer).
筆旋轉改變筆尖	Pen rotation changes the tip
轉動筆身時，麥克筆的斜切筆頭與油畫、壓克力的筆毛方向跟著轉。	When you rotate the barrel, the chisel tip of the marker and the bristles of oil and acrylic turn with it.
需要支援筆身旋轉的繪圖筆（例如 Wacom Art Pen）。	Needs a pen that supports barrel rotation (e.g. Wacom Art Pen).
對稱	Symmetry
畫一筆同時畫出對稱的複本：左右、上下、上下左右，或繞照片中心旋轉、萬花筒（每份再鏡射）。	Each stroke also draws symmetric copies: left-right, up-down, both, or rotated around the photo center, or kaleidoscope (each copy mirrored again).
等分數用下面的「等分」調整；形狀、特效筆、粒子筆也都會對稱。	Set the number of segments with "Segments" below; shapes, effect brushes and particle brushes are mirrored too.
等分	Segments
旋轉、萬花筒對稱的份數。	Number of copies for rotational and kaleidoscope symmetry.
圖說文字的字型。	Font of callout text.
字級	Font size
圖說文字的大小；文字放不下時會自動縮小。	Size of callout text; it shrinks automatically when the text doesn't fit.
所有繪圖圖層，上面的蓋在下面的上面；群組是資料夾，點箭頭收合。點選以選取（群組列選整個群組），Ctrl／Shift＋點選多選；點眼睛隱藏、點鎖頭鎖定（群組一起）。	All drawing layers; upper ones cover lower ones. Groups are folders; click the arrow to collapse. Click to select (a group row selects the whole group), Ctrl/Shift+click for multiple; click the eye to hide, the lock to lock (groups together).
按兩下改名稱；右鍵有群組、解散、上下移動。拖曳一列放到群組上＝移進群組，放到圖層上＝移到它上面。	Double-click to rename; right-click for group, ungroup and move up/down. Drag a row onto a group to move it into the group, onto a layer to move it above that layer.
新增點陣圖層：空白的點陣圖層，切換到直接繪製，接著畫的都畫在這一層。新增群組：空的群組並進入，接著畫的圖形都放進去（像先開一個圖層再畫）。	New raster layer: an empty raster layer; switches to direct painting and everything you paint goes on it. New group: an empty group that you enter, and shapes you draw go into it (like opening a layer before drawing).
複製選取的圖層（多選時全部），放在稍微偏右下的位置。	Duplicate the selected layer (all of them when several are selected), placed slightly to the lower right.
先選取一個圖層。	Select a layer first.
把選取的圖層或整個群組往上移一層（在同一個群組裡）。	Move the selected layer or whole group up one level (within the same group).
先選取一個圖層或一個群組。	Select a layer or a group first.
把選取的圖層或整個群組往下移一層（在同一個群組裡）。	Move the selected layer or whole group down one level (within the same group).
修改鋼筆路徑：點選路徑後拖曳節點移動、拖曳藍色把手改彎曲。	Edit pen paths: click a path, then drag nodes to move them and drag the blue handles to change curves.
Shift＋點選節點多選；Alt＋拖曳把手只動一邊（變尖角）；按兩下路徑加節點、按兩下節點刪除、Del 刪除選取的節點。其他圖形先按「轉成曲線」。	Shift+click nodes for multiple; Alt+drag a handle to move only one side (making a corner); double-click a path to add a node, double-click a node to delete it, Del deletes selected nodes. For other shapes, click "Convert to curves" first.
鋼筆	Pen
像 Illustrator、CorelDRAW 的鋼筆：點一下加尖角節點，按住拖曳拉出平滑曲線。	A pen like Illustrator's or CorelDRAW's: click to add corner nodes, drag to pull out smooth curves.
點回第一個節點封閉路徑；按兩下、Enter 或 Esc 完成。畫好後用節點工具修改。	Click the first node to close the path; double-click, Enter or Esc to finish. Edit it afterwards with the Node tool.
尖角	Cusp
選取的節點變成尖角：兩邊的把手可以各自往不同方向。	Make the selected nodes corners: the two handles can point in different directions.
平滑	Smooth
選取的節點變成平滑：兩邊把手保持一直線（長度可以不同），曲線過節點時不會折角。	Make the selected nodes smooth: both handles stay in a straight line (lengths may differ), so the curve doesn't bend sharply at the node.
選取的節點變成對稱：兩邊把手一直線且一樣長。	Make the selected nodes symmetric: both handles in a straight line and of equal length.
刪節點	Delete node
刪除選取的節點（Del），路徑由前後節點直接接起來。	Delete the selected nodes (Del); the path joins the neighboring nodes directly.
斷開	Break
在選取的節點把路徑斷開：封閉路徑變成開放路徑，開放路徑分成兩條。	Break the path at the selected node: a closed path becomes open, an open path splits in two.
封閉／開放	Close / open
把開放路徑的頭尾接起來成為封閉圖形（可以填色），或把封閉路徑打開。	Join the ends of an open path into a closed shape (which can be filled), or open a closed path.
接合	Join
選兩個開放路徑的端點（Shift＋點選）：同一條路徑就封閉，不同路徑就接成一條。	Select two end nodes of open paths (Shift+click): on the same path it closes, on different paths they join into one.
轉成曲線	Convert to curves
把選取的圖形轉成鋼筆路徑，之後用節點工具任意改形狀；文字、圖說的字會變成外框（每個字一個鋼筆路徑）。	Convert the selected shapes to pen paths so you can reshape them freely with the Node tool; text in text and callouts becomes outlines (one pen path per character).
轉了之後原本的圓角、角數、黃點等設定與文字內容就不能再改。點陣圖層、填滿圖層不能轉。	After converting, the original corner radius, point count, yellow dots and text content can no longer be changed. Raster and fill layers can't be converted.
靠左對齊	Align left
選取的物件左邊對齊（群組算一個）；只選一個時對齊照片的左邊。	Align the left edges of the selected objects (a group counts as one); with only one selected, align it to the left of the photo.
水平置中	Center horizontally
選取的物件左右置中對齊；只選一個時放到照片的水平中間。	Center the selected objects horizontally; with only one selected, move it to the horizontal center of the photo.
靠右對齊	Align right
選取的物件右邊對齊；只選一個時對齊照片的右邊。	Align the right edges of the selected objects; with only one selected, align it to the right of the photo.
靠上對齊	Align top
選取的物件上緣對齊；只選一個時對齊照片的上緣。	Align the top edges of the selected objects; with only one selected, align it to the top of the photo.
垂直置中	Center vertically
選取的物件上下置中對齊；只選一個時放到照片的垂直中間。	Center the selected objects vertically; with only one selected, move it to the vertical center of the photo.
靠下對齊	Align bottom
選取的物件下緣對齊；只選一個時對齊照片的下緣。	Align the bottom edges of the selected objects; with only one selected, align it to the bottom of the photo.
水平均分	Distribute horizontally
三個以上的物件：最左、最右的不動，中間的排成左右間距一樣。	Three or more objects: the leftmost and rightmost stay put and the ones between get equal horizontal spacing.
垂直均分	Distribute vertically
三個以上的物件：最上、最下的不動，中間的排成上下間距一樣。	Three or more objects: the top and bottom ones stay put and the ones between get equal vertical spacing.
焊接	Weld
把選取的圖形合成一個外形（樣式用最上面的）。	Combine the selected shapes into one outline (using the style of the topmost).
結果是鋼筆路徑，可以用節點工具修改；原本的圓角、角數等設定不能再調。圖說、點陣圖層、開放的線不能焊接。	The result is a pen path you can edit with the Node tool; corner radius, point count and similar settings can no longer be adjusted. Callouts, raster layers and open lines can't be welded.
修剪	Trim
最下面的圖形減掉上面所有的圖形（樣式用最下面的），像用餅乾模切掉一塊。	Subtract all shapes above from the bottom shape (using the bottom shape's style), like a cookie cutter.
結果是鋼筆路徑；上面那些圖形會拿掉，要保留可以先複製一份。	The result is a pen path; the shapes above are removed, so duplicate them first if you want to keep them.
相交	Intersect
只留下全部圖形都重疊的地方（樣式用最上面的）。	Keep only where all the shapes overlap (using the style of the topmost).
排除	Exclude
重疊的地方挖空，其餘合成一個圖形（樣式用最上面的）。	Cut out the overlapping areas and combine the rest into one shape (using the style of the topmost).
重疊的圖形切成一塊一塊：在幾塊上拖曳就合成一塊，按住 Alt 點（或拖）刪掉那幾塊。	Overlapping shapes are cut into pieces: drag across pieces to merge them into one, Alt+click (or drag) to delete pieces.
像 Illustrator 的形狀建立工具；Esc、Enter 或點外面結束。結果都是鋼筆路徑。	Like Illustrator's Shape Builder; Esc, Enter or clicking outside finishes. The results are all pen paths.
放大後拖曳移動畫面。	Drag to move the view when zoomed in.
任何工具按住滑鼠中鍵拖曳也可以平移。	With any tool, dragging with the middle mouse button pans too.
點一下放大、Alt＋點（或右鍵）縮小；拖一個框放大到那個範圍。	Click to zoom in, Alt+click (or right-click) to zoom out; drag a box to zoom to that area.
在照片上點一下吸取顏色：左鍵設成線條色，右鍵（或 Shift＋點）設成填色。	Click on the photo to pick a color: left button sets the line color, right button (or Shift+click) sets the fill color.
其他工具按住 Alt 點一下也能吸色。	With other tools, Alt+click picks a color too.
擦掉目前點陣圖層上畫過的地方（上方可以換成漂白、加深）。	Erase painted areas on the current raster layer (switch to bleach or darken above).
B 換回筆刷、E 換成橡皮擦；用筆刷時按住右鍵或用繪圖筆的橡皮擦端也能暫時擦。	B returns to the brush, E switches to the eraser; while using a brush, hold the right button or use the pen's eraser end to erase temporarily.
仿製印章	Clone stamp
先 Alt＋點一下設定來源，再拖曳把來源的照片畫過來（同 Photoshop 的仿製印章）。	Alt+click to set the source, then drag to paint the source part of the photo here (like Photoshop's Clone Stamp).
結果畫在點陣圖層，原圖不動。按住展開可以換成修復筆。	The result goes onto a raster layer; the original is untouched. Press and hold to switch to the healing brush.
修復筆	Healing brush
像仿製印章一樣 Alt＋點設定來源，但只取來源的紋理，顏色與亮度自動融入塗抹的地方，適合去斑、去瑕疵。	Alt+click to set the source like the clone stamp, but only the texture is taken; color and brightness blend into the painted area automatically. Good for removing spots and flaws.
結果畫在點陣圖層，原圖不動。	The result goes onto a raster layer; the original is untouched.
塗抹	Smudge
把照片與下面圖層的顏色沿筆畫推開、抹勻（同 Photoshop 的指尖、Painter 的塗抹）。	Push and smooth the colors of the photo and layers below along the stroke (like Photoshop's Smudge and Painter's Smear).
濕度越高推得越遠。按住展開可以換成混色筆。	Higher wetness pushes farther. Press and hold to switch to the blender.
混色	Blend
帶著線條色畫，同時沾起畫布上的顏色混在一起（濕畫）。	Paint with the line color while picking up and mixing the colors on the canvas (wet painting).
模糊	Blur
在照片上塗抹讓那裡變柔和，越塗越糊。	Paint on the photo to soften that area; more passes make it blurrier.
不透明度控制強度、粗細控制範圍。結果畫在點陣圖層。按住展開可以換成銳利化。	Opacity sets the strength, width sets the area. The result goes onto a raster layer. Press and hold to switch to sharpen.
銳利化	Sharpen
塗抹讓細節更清楚；塗太多次會出現雜點。	Paint to make details crisper; too many passes create noise.
結果畫在點陣圖層。	The result goes onto a raster layer.
加亮	Dodge
塗抹讓那裡變亮（同暗房的遮光）。	Paint to lighten that area (like dodging in a darkroom).
按住展開可以換成加深、海綿。結果畫在點陣圖層。	Press and hold to switch to burn or sponge. The result goes onto a raster layer.
加深	Burn
塗抹讓那裡變暗（同暗房的加光）。	Paint to darken that area (like burning in a darkroom).
海綿	Sponge
塗抹降低或增加顏色的飽和度（兩種海綿在展開選單裡）。	Paint to decrease or increase color saturation (both sponges are in the flyout menu).
拖一條線穿過圖形把它切開（Shift：45°）；有選取時只切選取的。	Drag a line across shapes to cut them (Shift: 45°); with a selection, only the selected shapes are cut.
封閉圖形切成幾塊、開放的線在交點斷開，結果都是鋼筆路徑。圖說、文字、點陣圖層不能切。	Closed shapes are cut into pieces, open lines are broken at the intersections; all results are pen paths. Callouts, text and raster layers can't be cut.
拖一個框（或點一下）輸入文字；字型、字級、文字色在右側面板。	Drag a box (or click) to type text; font, size and text color are in the right panel.
預設沒有框；勾「外框」「填色」就是文字方塊。按兩下可以再改文字。	No frame by default; check "Outline" and "Fill" for a text box. Double-click to edit the text again.
線條樣式	Line style
實線、虛線、點線、點虛線、長虛線；虛線的長短跟著線寬變。	Solid, dashed, dotted, dash-dot, long dash; dash lengths follow the line width.
每種筆刷都能畫虛線（水彩、炭筆也可以）。	Every brush can draw dashed lines (watercolor and charcoal too).
端點	Caps
線條兩端的樣子：圓頭、平頭（剛好停在端點）、方頭（多出半個線寬的方角）。	How the line ends look: round, flat (stopping exactly at the end point), square (extending half a line width with square corners).
平頭、方頭時線條用幾何外框畫，筆壓的粗細變化不會出現。	With flat or square caps the line is drawn as a geometric outline, so pressure width variation doesn't show.
轉角	Joins
線條轉彎處的樣子：圓角、尖角、斜角。	How line corners look: round, miter, bevel.
尖角、斜角時線條用幾何外框畫。	With miter or bevel joins the line is drawn as a geometric outline.
起點／終點箭頭	Start / end arrow
開放線條兩端的箭頭：三角、開放、圓點、方塊、菱形。	Arrowheads at the ends of open lines: triangle, open, dot, square, diamond.
直線、曲線、自由繪製、開放的鋼筆路徑才會加；封閉圖形不加。	Added only to lines, curves, freehand and open pen paths; not to closed shapes.
選取範圍左邊的位置（照片像素）。	Left position of the selection (photo pixels).
Enter 套用；上下鍵加減 1，Shift＋上下鍵加減 10。	Enter applies; Up/Down change it by 1, Shift+Up/Down by 10.
選取範圍上緣的位置（照片像素）。	Top position of the selection (photo pixels).
寬	W
選取範圍的寬度（照片像素）；鎖頭按下時高度等比例跟著變。	Width of the selection (photo pixels); with the lock on, the height follows proportionally.
高	H
選取範圍的高度（照片像素）；鎖頭按下時寬度等比例跟著變。	Height of the selection (photo pixels); with the lock on, the width follows proportionally.
角度	Angle
方框類圖形、文字、圖說：直接設定角度。其他（線條、鋼筆路徑、多選）：輸入要再轉幾度。	Box shapes, text and callouts: set the angle directly. Others (lines, pen paths, multiple selection): type how many more degrees to rotate.
鎖定比例	Lock proportions
按下時改寬或高，另一邊等比例跟著變。	When on, changing width or height changes the other proportionally.
更多對齊	More alignment
靠右、垂直置中、靠下，以及水平、垂直均分（三個以上）。	Align right, center vertically, align bottom, and distribute horizontally or vertically (three or more).
放進形狀（PowerClip）	Place inside shape (PowerClip)
把選取的東西放進最上面那個封閉圖形裡，只看得到形狀裡面的部分（同 CorelDRAW 的 PowerClip）。	Put the selected items inside the topmost closed shape so only the part inside the shape shows (like CorelDRAW's PowerClip).
框的填色在內容下面、外框在內容上面；移動、縮放框時內容跟著動，雙擊進去可以單獨移動內容。	The frame's fill is below the contents and its outline above; moving or resizing the frame moves the contents too. Double-click to enter and move the contents alone.
取出內容	Extract contents
把 PowerClip 的框和內容分開，變回各自的圖層。	Separate a PowerClip's frame and contents back into their own layers.
照片放進形狀	Clip photo to shape
照片只留選取的封閉圖形裡面，外面變透明（匯出時預設存 PNG）；再按一次取消。	Keep only the part of the photo inside the selected closed shape; outside becomes transparent (exported as PNG by default). Click again to cancel.
形狀可以再移動、縮放、改節點，照片跟著變；形狀隱藏時照樣裁切。	The shape can still be moved, resized and node-edited and the photo follows; the clip works even when the shape is hidden.
在線條、圖形圍起來的地方點一下，那塊區域變成新的向量圖形（同 CorelDRAW 的智慧填色）。	Click inside an area enclosed by lines and shapes to turn it into a new vector shape (like CorelDRAW's Smart Fill).
用目前的填色（可以是漸層）、沒有線條，放在圍住它的線條下面。線條要接起來才填得到；圖形裡面有其他圖形時會挖洞。	Uses the current fill (gradients too) with no outline, placed below the lines that enclose it. Lines must connect to be filled; shapes inside make holes.
封閉圖形的填色：單色、線性漸層、放射漸層（填色 → 第二色）。	Fill of closed shapes: solid, linear gradient, radial gradient (fill → second color).
選了漸層後，選取工具會在圖形上顯示起點（圓）和終點（方塊），拖曳調整方向與範圍；圖形移動、縮放時漸層跟著。	After choosing a gradient, the Select tool shows the start (circle) and end (square) on the shape; drag to change its direction and extent. The gradient follows when the shape moves or resizes.
漸層填色的第二個顏色（填色是第一個）。	Second color of the gradient fill (the fill color is the first).
文字沿路徑	Text on path
選一個文字和一條線（或任何圖形），讓文字沿著那條線排列（同 CorelDRAW 的「文字適合路徑」）。	Select a text and a line (or any shape) to run the text along that line (like CorelDRAW's Fit Text to Path).
封閉的圖形（圓形）排在最上面，做印章、標誌很方便。原本的圖形還在。	On closed shapes (circles) the text runs along the top, handy for seals and logos. The original shape is kept.
位置	Position
文字沿路徑往前或往後移（路徑長度的 −50% 到 50%）。	Move the text forward or backward along the path (−50% to 50% of the path length).
Enter 套用；上下鍵加減 1，Shift＋上下鍵加減 5。	Enter applies; Up/Down change it by 1, Shift+Up/Down by 5.
換到另一邊	Flip side
文字換到線的另一邊、方向反過來（圓形時排到下面，字是正的）。	Move the text to the other side of the line and reverse its direction (on circles it runs along the bottom, upright).
離開路徑	Detach from path
文字不再沿路徑排，變回一般的文字方框。	The text no longer follows the path and becomes a normal text box again.
互動式陰影	Interactive shadow
在圖形上按住往外拖：拖的方向和距離就是陰影的位置（同 CorelDRAW 的陰影工具）。	Press on a shape and drag outward: the direction and distance of the drag set the shadow position (like CorelDRAW's Drop Shadow tool).
上方可以調柔邊、不透明度、陰影色，或移除陰影。	Above you can adjust softness, opacity and shadow color, or remove the shadow.
互動式透明度	Interactive transparency
在圖形上從要保持不透明的地方拖到要變透明的地方，圖形就漸漸淡掉。	Drag across a shape from where it stays opaque to where it becomes transparent, and the shape fades out gradually.
上方可以換成放射（從中心往外淡）、移除。整個圖形（含陰影）一起變淡。	Above you can switch to radial (fading out from the center) or remove it. The whole shape (including its shadow) fades together.
點一個圖形，拖曳框的四角（白）和四邊中點（黃）把圖形彎曲變形（同 CorelDRAW 的封套）。	Click a shape and drag the corners (white) and side midpoints (yellow) of its box to bend and warp it (like CorelDRAW's Envelope).
結果是鋼筆路徑；在換工具或點別的圖形之前都可以「重設封套」。文字先轉成曲線再套。	The result is a pen path; until you change tools or click another shape you can "Reset envelope". Convert text to curves first.
陰影柔邊	Shadow softness
陰影邊緣的模糊程度（照片高度的千分比）；「自動」依線寬。	Blur of the shadow edge (per mille of the photo height); "Auto" follows the line width.
陰影的濃淡（0～100%）。	How dark the shadow is (0–100%).
陰影色	Shadow color
陰影的顏色（打開選色視窗的「陰影」）。	Color of the shadow (opens "Shadow" in the color window).
移除陰影	Remove shadow
拿掉這個圖形的陰影。	Remove this shape's shadow.
透明度類型	Transparency type
線性：沿拖曳的方向變淡；放射：從起點往外一圈圈變淡。	Linear: fades along the drag direction; Radial: fades in rings from the start point.
移除透明	Remove transparency
拿掉透明度漸層，圖形恢復不透明。	Remove the transparency gradient so the shape is opaque again.
重設封套	Reset envelope
回到套封套之前的形狀。	Return to the shape before the envelope was applied.
調和	Blend
在選取的兩個圖形之間產生中間的圖形，形狀、顏色、線寬、不透明度逐步變過去（同 CorelDRAW 的調和）。	Create in-between shapes between the two selected shapes, gradually changing shape, color, line width and opacity (like CorelDRAW's Blend).
結果和兩端組成群組；之後改兩端不會自動更新。	The result is grouped with the two ends; changing the ends later doesn't update it.
步數	Steps
中間要產生幾個圖形（1～50）。	How many in-between shapes to create (1–50).
更多按鈕	More buttons
視窗太窄時，放不下的按鈕收在這裡（點了跟按原本的按鈕一樣）。	When the window is too narrow, buttons that don't fit are kept here (clicking one is the same as the original button).
把視窗拉寬，按鈕就會回到操作列上。	Widen the window and the buttons return to the action bar.
群組	Group
把選取的物件組成群組（Ctrl+G）：之後點一下就選到整個群組，一起移動、縮放、旋轉；雙擊進去編輯裡面的物件。	Group the selected objects (Ctrl+G): one click then selects the whole group to move, resize and rotate together; double-click to enter and edit the objects inside.
解散群組	Ungroup
把選取的群組拆開（Ctrl+Shift+G），裡面的物件回到上一層，位置不變。	Break up the selected group (Ctrl+Shift+G); its objects go up one level and stay in place.
離開群組	Exit group
結束群組編輯，回到上一層（也可以按 Esc，或點群組外面的物件）。	Finish editing the group and return to the level above (or press Esc, or click an object outside the group).
快捷鍵 Del；可以按復原救回來。	Shortcut Del; Undo brings it back.
填滿圖層	Fill layer
新增一個單色、漸層或材質的圖層（同 Photoshop 的填滿圖層），之後在圖層清單按兩下可以隨時再改。	Add a solid color, gradient or texture layer (like Photoshop's fill layers); double-click it in the layer list to change it any time.
有選取範圍時只填在範圍裡（遮色片）；不透明度與混合模式用圖層的設定。	With a selection it fills only inside it (as a mask); opacity and blend mode use the layer settings.
目前無法使用：	Not available right now:
（尚未選圖）	(No image selected)
把照片拖曳到這裡，或從「檔案 → 載入／新增」	Drag a photo here, or use "File → Load / New"
停止	Stop
宮崎風	Ghibli style
隨機	Random
畫面描述（英文，可空白）	Scene description (English, optional)
（模型要另外下載，放在 Models\\）	(The model must be downloaded separately and placed in Models\\)
按「生成」開始（用顯卡）。	Click "Generate" to start (uses the graphics card).
打底與畫線稿…	Base painting and line art…
重繪中 {0}/{1}…	Redrawing {0}/{1}…
完成（{0:0} 秒）。不滿意可以換種子或強度再生成。	Done ({0:0} s). If you don't like it, try another seed or strength.
已停止。	Stopped.
生成失敗：	Generation failed:
美顏手動調整	Manual beauty adjustments
肌膚	Skin
五官	Features
臉型	Face shape
美妝	Makeup
戲曲	Opera
確定	OK
取消	Cancel
白皙	Fair
小麥	Tan
口紅、眼影、眼線、睫毛、美瞳、雙眼皮、眉毛、腮紅、高光、髮色在「美妝」頁。	Lipstick, eye shadow, eyeliner, lashes, colored contacts, double eyelids, eyebrows, blush, highlight and hair color are on the "Makeup" page.
短	Short
長	Long
薄	Thin
厚	Full
需要臉部特徵點（Models\\face_landmarks.onnx 或 lbfmodel.yaml），目前停用。	Needs facial landmarks (Models\\face_landmarks.onnx or lbfmodel.yaml); currently disabled.
眉形（挑眉、平眉、柳葉）在「美妝」頁的眉毛。	Brow shapes (arched, straight, willow) are under Eyebrows on the "Makeup" page.
種類	Type
無	None
柔光	Soft light
林布蘭光	Rembrandt
側光	Side light
光從左邊	Light from left
光從右邊	Light from right
有 478 點網格時，林布蘭光與側光依臉的立體起伏打光。	With the 478-point mesh, Rembrandt and side light follow the 3D contours of the face.
沒有 478 點網格時，光影以左右漸層表現。	Without the 478-point mesh, lighting is shown as a left-right gradient.

透明度：在圖形上從要保持不透明的地方拖到要變透明的地方；上方可以換成放射、移除。	Transparency: drag across a shape from where it stays opaque to where it becomes transparent; switch to radial or remove it above.
封套：點一個圖形，拖曳四角（白）和四邊中點（黃）把圖形彎曲變形；結果是鋼筆路徑。	Envelope: click a shape and drag the corners (white) and side midpoints (yellow) to warp it; the result is a pen path.

：結果是鋼筆路徑，可以用節點工具再修改。	: the result is a pen path you can edit further with the Node tool.
刀線要整個穿過圖形才切得開（圖說、文字、點陣圖層不能切）。	The knife line must cross the whole shape to cut it (callouts, text and raster layers can't be cut).
已切開：{0} 個圖形變成 {1} 個（都是鋼筆路徑）。	Cut: {0} shapes became {1} (all pen paths).
平移：拖曳移動畫面（放大後才需要）。任何工具按住滑鼠中鍵拖曳也可以平移。	Pan: drag to move the view (needed only when zoomed in). With any tool, dragging with the middle button pans too.
縮放：點一下放大、Alt＋點（或右鍵）縮小，拖一個框放大到那個範圍。	Zoom: click to zoom in, Alt+click (or right-click) to zoom out, drag a box to zoom to that area.
吸管：點一下吸成線條色，右鍵（或 Shift＋點）吸成填色；可以按住拖曳看顏色。	Eyedropper: click to pick the line color, right-click (or Shift+click) to pick the fill color; hold and drag to preview colors.
智慧填色：在線條、圖形圍起來的地方點一下，那塊變成新的圖形（用目前的填色，可以先在右側選漸層）。線條要接起來才填得到。	Smart fill: click inside an area enclosed by lines and shapes to turn it into a new shape (uses the current fill; you can choose a gradient on the right first). Lines must connect to be filled.
刀具：拖一條線穿過圖形把它切開（Shift：45°）；有選取時只切選取的。結果是鋼筆路徑。	Knife: drag a line across shapes to cut them (Shift: 45°); with a selection, only selected shapes are cut. Results are pen paths.
形狀建立：先點選或框選兩個以上重疊的封閉圖形，選好就切成一塊一塊。	Shape builder: first click or marquee-select two or more overlapping closed shapes; they are then cut into pieces.
文字：拖一個框（或點一下）輸入文字；字型、字級、文字色在右側面板。勾「外框」「填色」就是文字方塊。	Text: drag a box (or click) to type text; font, size and text color are in the right panel. Check "Outline" and "Fill" for a text box.
修復筆：拖曳把來源（十字準星）的紋理畫過來，顏色亮度自動融入周圍；Alt＋點一下換來源。	Healing brush: drag to paint the texture from the source (crosshair); color and brightness blend into the surroundings; Alt+click to change the source.
修復筆：先按住 Alt 在照片上點一下，設定要取樣的來源（像仿製筆）。	Healing brush: first Alt+click on the photo to set the source to sample (like the clone brush).
模糊：在照片上塗抹讓那裡變柔和（越塗越糊；不透明度控制強度）。結果畫在點陣圖層，原圖不動。	Blur: paint on the photo to soften it (more passes are blurrier; opacity sets strength). The result goes onto a raster layer; the original is untouched.
銳利化：塗抹讓細節更清楚（別塗太多次會出現雜點）。結果畫在點陣圖層。	Sharpen: paint to make details crisper (too many passes create noise). The result goes onto a raster layer.
加亮：塗抹讓那裡變亮（同暗房的遮光）。結果畫在點陣圖層。	Dodge: paint to lighten (like dodging in a darkroom). The result goes onto a raster layer.
加深：塗抹讓那裡變暗（同暗房的加光）。結果畫在點陣圖層。	Burn: paint to darken (like burning in a darkroom). The result goes onto a raster layer.
海綿（降低飽和）：塗抹讓顏色變淡、接近灰色。結果畫在點陣圖層。	Sponge (desaturate): paint to make colors paler, toward gray. The result goes onto a raster layer.
海綿（增加飽和）：塗抹讓顏色更鮮豔。結果畫在點陣圖層。	Sponge (saturate): paint to make colors more vivid. The result goes onto a raster layer.

鍾馗（蝙蝠）	Zhong Kui (bat)
紅臉：火焰眼竄向太陽穴、黑掃帚眉，額頭展翅黑蝙蝠（取「福」），鼻子以下整塊白、紅元寶下巴，鼻樑捲紋。捉鬼的判官。	Red face: flame eyes shooting toward the temples, black broom brows, a black bat spreading its wings on the forehead (for "fortune"), solid white below the nose, a red ingot chin, curls on the nose bridge. The ghost-catching judge.
紅臉、額頭金黃：金色火焰柱（藍焰心）、黑淚形眼窩描白、頰上金斑、金鼻樑、下巴金火焰。性情剛烈的武將。	Red face with a golden forehead: a gold flame pillar (blue flame core), black teardrop eye sockets outlined in white, gold spots on the cheeks, a gold nose bridge, gold flames on the chin. A hot-tempered warrior.
藍臉：紅色水滴印堂描白邊、黑掃帚眉、白葉眼斑，太陽穴與臉頰捲起白雲紋、白鼻樑、白下巴。勇猛剛直、有神通的角色。	Blue face: a red drop between the brows outlined in white, black broom brows, white leaf eye patches, white cloud curls on the temples and cheeks, a white nose bridge and chin. A brave, upright character with supernatural powers.
金臉（金屬光澤）：額頭一排紅點、紅火焰印堂，金眼眶配銀眼斑，臉頰乾淨只點紅，紅鼻頭、紅元寶下巴。天神、佛一類的角色。	Gold face (metallic sheen): a row of red dots on the forehead, a red flame between the brows, gold eye frames with silver eye patches, clean cheeks with just a touch of red, a red nose tip, a red ingot chin. Deities and Buddhas.
綠臉：黃色火焰印堂、下垂的黑淚眼（裡面一圈黃）、臉頰外側紅紋夾黑線、鼻樑捲紋、黑三角下巴、嘴角獠牙，額頭水波紋。山精水怪一類的角色。	Green face: a yellow flame between the brows, drooping black teardrop eyes (with a yellow ring inside), red lines with black stripes on the outer cheeks, curls on the nose bridge, a black triangular chin, fangs at the mouth corners, water ripples on the forehead. Mountain spirits and water monsters.
太極臉	Taiji face
紅臉、額頭黑白太極描金，黑掃帚眉、黑淚形眼窩、頰上白斑捲紋、白鼻樑。亦正亦邪、有道行的角色。	Red face with a gold-outlined black-and-white taiji on the forehead, black broom brows, black teardrop eye sockets, white curled patches on the cheeks, a white nose bridge. Ambiguous characters with magical powers.
陰陽臉	Yin-yang face
左黑右白的陰陽臉：兩邊的眉、眼窩、捲紋用相反的顏色，鼻樑紅火焰。川劇不對稱臉譜的代表畫法。	Black on the left, white on the right: brows, eye sockets and curls use opposite colors on each side, with a red flame on the nose bridge. The classic asymmetric Sichuan mask.
黃臉	Yellow face
黃臉：額頭一排紅點、紅火焰印堂，火焰眼、臉頰外側黑紋夾紅線、紅鼻頭、紅元寶下巴。驍勇、性格暴躁的角色。	Yellow face: a row of red dots on the forehead, a red flame between the brows, flame eyes, black lines with red stripes on the outer cheeks, a red nose tip, a red ingot chin. A valiant, hot-tempered character.
粉臉	Pink face
粉紅臉：紅色水滴印堂、黑掃帚眉、白葉眼斑、白鼻樑，鼻子以下整塊紅、白下巴。年老或帶喜氣的武將。	Pink face: a red drop between the brows, black broom brows, white leaf eye patches, a white nose bridge, solid red below the nose, a white chin. An old or festive warrior.
川丑・豆腐乾	Sichuan clown · Tofu patch
川丑最典型的小花臉：鼻樑一塊花邊白豆腐乾，裡面畫捲曲小眉、小眼、紅鼻頭，額頭紅花、雙頰紅暈加捲紋。	The most typical Sichuan clown face: a white tofu patch with a decorative edge on the nose bridge, with curly little brows, small eyes and a red nose tip inside, a red flower on the forehead, red cheeks with curls.
川丑・銅錢	Sichuan clown · Coin
白鼻塊中間一枚金銅錢（外圈花邊、方孔），上下各一個捲紋：貪財、勢利的市井小人物。	A gold coin (decorative rim, square hole) in the middle of the white nose patch, with a curl above and below: a greedy, snobbish little townsman.
川丑・蝙蝠	Sichuan clown · Bat
鼻樑畫成展翅的白蝙蝠（描黑邊、翅膀有骨紋），翅膀伸到眼下，紅鼻頭：機靈、會鑽營的小人物。	The nose bridge painted as a white bat with spread wings (outlined in black, with ribbed wings) reaching under the eyes, a red nose tip: a clever, scheming little character.
青白鬼臉	Pale ghost face
青白的臉、發黑下垂的眼眶、臉頰凹陷、暗紫唇，額前幾縷亂髮。冤魂、鬼魂一類的角色。	A pale bluish face, dark drooping eye sockets, hollow cheeks, dark purple lips, a few loose strands of hair on the forehead. Wronged spirits and ghosts.

筆畫預覽	Stroke preview
三種方式依電腦的負載由輕到重排列；畫起來不順時往上選。	The three modes are listed from lightest to heaviest load; if drawing feels sluggish, choose one higher up.
快速線條（負載最輕）	Quick line (lightest)
只畫一條依筆壓變粗細的線，放開後才看到筆刷的質感。舊電腦、很大的筆刷最順。	Draws only a line whose width follows pressure; the brush texture appears when you release. Smoothest on old computers and with very large brushes.
逐段筆印（負載中等）	Incremental dabs (medium)
像 Painter：邊畫邊只把新增的筆印疊上去，筆畫再長也不會越畫越慢；混色、塗抹、仿製、模糊等會讀畫布的筆也看得到效果。收尾變細、筆毛乾掉等要知道整筆長度的效果放開時才出現；特效筆、粒子、乾刷、陰影自動改用真實筆刷。	Like Painter: only the new dabs are added as you draw, so even long strokes stay fast; brushes that read the canvas (blender, smudge, clone, blur…) show their effect too. Effects that need the whole stroke length (tapering ends, bristles running dry) appear when you release; effect brushes, particles, dry brush and shadows use Real brush automatically.
真實筆刷（負載最重，預設）	Real brush (heaviest, default)
每次把整筆重新算一遍，看到的就是放開後的樣子；筆畫越長越吃力。混色、塗抹等讀畫布的筆畫的時候用快速線條。	Recomputes the whole stroke every time, so you see exactly the final result; longer strokes take more work. Brushes that read the canvas (blender, smudge…) show a quick line while drawing.

macOS（按鈕在左）	macOS (buttons on the left)
KDE Plasma（按鈕在右）	KDE Plasma (buttons on the right)
標題列的最小化、最大化、關閉按鈕與選單列的標誌；點了立刻套用。	The minimize, maximize and close buttons in the title bar and the logo in the menu bar; applies as soon as you click.

正多邊形	Regular Polygon
拖曳畫出正多邊形；上方的「邊數」可以設 3～64 邊。	Drag to draw a regular polygon; set 3–64 sides with "Sides" above.
按住 Shift 拖曳畫成正的（不壓扁）。	Hold Shift while dragging to keep it unsquashed.
拖曳畫出星形；上方設定角數（3～64）和內徑（尖角的深淺），也可以拖曳黃點調整。	Drag to draw a star; set the points (3–64) and inner radius (how deep the points are) above, or drag the yellow handle.
螺旋	Spiral
拖曳畫出由中心往外繞的螺旋線；上方設定圈數。	Drag to draw a spiral winding out from the center; set the turns above.
螺旋是開放的線，只有線條沒有填色。	A spiral is an open line: outline only, no fill.
格紙	Graph Paper
拖曳畫出一張格子（表格線）；上方設定欄數和列數。	Drag to draw a grid; set the columns and rows above.
拖曳畫出扇形、弧線或弓形；上方設定起點角度和張開的角度，也可以拖曳兩個黃點。	Drag to draw a pie, arc or chord; set the start angle and sweep above, or drag the two yellow handles.
點一個圖形吸取它的外觀（填色、漸層、線條、筆刷、陰影、透明度），再點其他圖形套上去（同 CorelDRAW 的屬性滴管、Illustrator 的滴管）。	Click a shape to pick up its appearance (fill, gradient, outline, brush, shadow, transparency), then click other shapes to apply it (like CorelDRAW's Attributes Eyedropper or Illustrator's Eyedropper).
先選好幾個物件，再用屬性吸管點來源，就一次套到全部。Shift＋點或 Esc 重新吸取。	Select several objects first, then click the source with the Attribute Eyedropper to apply it to all of them at once. Shift+click or Esc to pick again.
邊數／角數	Sides / Points
正多邊形的邊數、星形的角數（3～64）。	Number of sides of a regular polygon, or points of a star (3–64).
有選取圖形時改選取的圖形；沒有選取時改下一個要畫的圖形。	Changes the selected shape; with nothing selected, changes the next shape you draw.
星形凹進去的點離中心多遠（外徑的百分比）；越小尖角越尖。	How far the star's inner points are from the center (percent of the outer radius); smaller means sharper points.
螺旋繞幾圈（0.5～20）。	How many turns the spiral makes (0.5–20).
欄與列	Columns and Rows
格紙的欄數和列數（1～50）。	Number of columns and rows in the graph paper (1–50).
弧形樣式	Arc Style
扇形：連到中心的封閉圖形；弧線：只有弧線；弓形：弧的兩端直接連起來。	Pie: a closed shape joined to the center; Arc: the curve only; Chord: the two ends joined directly.
起點與角度	Start and Sweep
起點：弧從幾度開始（0 度在右邊、順時針）；角度：張開幾度（1～359）。	Start: the angle where the arc begins (0° is on the right, clockwise); Sweep: how many degrees it opens (1–359).
把選取的物件左右翻轉（同 CorelDRAW 屬性列的水平鏡射）。	Flip the selected objects left to right (like CorelDRAW's Mirror Horizontally on the property bar).
選很多個時以它們的整體中心翻轉，相對位置也跟著翻；漸層、文字方向一起正確處理。	With several selected, they flip around their combined center and their positions flip too; gradients and text direction are handled correctly.
把選取的物件上下翻轉。	Flip the selected objects top to bottom.
選很多個時以它們的整體中心翻轉。	With several selected, they flip around their combined center.
把線條變成一個可以填色的封閉圖形（同 CorelDRAW 的「外框轉換為物件」、Illustrator 的「外框筆畫」）。	Turn the outline into a closed shape you can fill (like CorelDRAW's Convert Outline to Object or Illustrator's Outline Stroke).
結果是鋼筆路徑，填色就是原本的線條色；原本有填色的話，填色部分保留成沒有線條的圖形。	The result is a pen path filled with the original outline color; if the original had a fill, the fill is kept as a shape without an outline.

修飾筆刷：先選取（或在上面按下）要修飾的向量圖形。	Touch-up Brush: select (or press on) the vector shape to touch up first.
效果 ▾	Effects ▾
修飾筆刷（{0}）：在選取的圖形邊緣拖曳推拉外形；轉動、吸引等按住不動會繼續作用。Alt＝反方向轉，[ ] 調大小。	Touch-up Brush ({0}): drag along the edge of the selected shape to push and pull it; Twirl, Attract and the others keep working while you hold still. Alt = reverse twirl, [ ] = size.
選取的向量圖形或文字套用效果：輪廓圖、變形效果、立體化、簡化路徑（編輯選單裡也有）。	Apply effects to the selected vector shapes or text: Contour, Distort, Extrude, Simplify Path (also in the Edit menu).
每個效果都有設定視窗，右邊即時預覽；按「確定」才套用，可以復原。	Each effect has a settings window with a live preview on the right; it's applied only when you click OK, and can be undone.
用筆刷推拉向量圖形的邊（同 CorelDRAW 的塗抹、轉動、吸引、排斥、粗糙筆刷，Illustrator 的平滑工具）。	Push and pull the edges of vector shapes with a brush (like CorelDRAW's Smear, Twirl, Attract, Repel and Roughen brushes, or Illustrator's Smooth tool).
先選取圖形（或直接在圖形上按下），沿著邊緣拖曳。放開時會簡化成平滑的曲線，拖一次算一步復原。	Select a shape (or press directly on it) and drag along its edge. On release it's simplified into smooth curves; each drag is one undo step.
筆刷模式	Brush Mode
塗抹：把邊往拖的方向推；轉動：繞著筆刷中心旋轉（Alt 反方向）；吸引／排斥：往中心拉、往外推；粗糙：邊變得凹凸；平滑：撫平抖動的邊。	Smear: pushes the edge the way you drag; Twirl: spins around the brush center (Alt reverses); Attract / Repel: pulls toward or pushes away from the center; Roughen: makes the edge bumpy; Smooth: evens out shaky edges.
筆刷圓的直徑（照片像素）；[ ] 鍵也可以調。	Diameter of the brush circle (photo pixels); the [ ] keys also change it.
每次作用的強弱（1～100%）。	How strong each application is (1–100%).
輪廓 {0}	Contour {0}
 立體	 Extrude
寬度工具	Width Tool
（左鍵線條、右鍵填色；按兩下編輯）	 (left-click: outline, right-click: fill; double-click to edit)
加入色票：左鍵加入目前的線條色、右鍵加入填色	Add swatch: left-click adds the current outline color, right-click adds the fill
色票	Swatches
圖樣	Pattern
直角	Elbow
單位	Unit
每單位像素	Pixels per unit
小數	Decimals
顯示尺規 (Ctrl+Alt+R)	Show Rulers (Ctrl+Alt+R)
顯示格線 (Ctrl+')	Show Grid (Ctrl+')
貼齊格線	Snap to Grid
貼齊參考線	Snap to Guides
格線間距…	Grid Spacing…
清除參考線	Clear Guides
格線間距	Grid Spacing
間距（照片像素）	Spacing (photo pixels)
參考線：{0} 像素	Guide: {0} px
之後畫的線條用「{0}」寬度。	Lines you draw next use the "{0}" width.
寬度工具：在線條上按住往外拖。	Width Tool: press on a line and drag outward.
寬度：{0}%	Width: {0}%
條紋	Stripes
棋盤	Checkerboard
斜格	Crosshatch
波浪	Waves
色票 {0}	Swatch {0}
已加入色票：改色票的顏色時，用到它的物件一起變（按兩下色票改顏色、名稱或刪除）。	Swatch added: change its color and every object using it changes too (double-click the swatch to change its color or name, or delete it).
「{0}」：{1} 個物件	"{0}": {1} objects
改顏色…	Change Color…
改名稱…	Rename…
色票名稱	Swatch Name
刪除色票	Delete Swatch
寬度工具：在線條上按住往外拖讓那裡變粗、往內拖變細；Alt＋點菱形刪掉控制點。上方可以套用寬度樣式。	Width Tool: press on a line and drag outward to thicken it there, inward to thin it; Alt+click a diamond to remove that point. Width styles are available above.
尺寸線	Dimension Line
從一點拖到另一點量距離，標上長度（同 CorelDRAW 的尺度工具）；拖中間的黃點把尺寸線移開。	Drag from one point to another to measure and label the distance (like CorelDRAW's Dimension tools); drag the yellow handle in the middle to move the line away.
上方可以選平行、水平、垂直，單位（像素、公釐、公分、公尺、英吋）和小數位數；文字欄填「寬 {0}」可以自訂標籤。	Above you can choose aligned, horizontal or vertical, the unit (px, mm, cm, m, in) and decimals; type e.g. "Width {0}" as the text for a custom label.
連接線	Connector
從一個物件拖到另一個物件：兩端連上之後，移動物件時線會跟著（畫流程圖用）。	Drag from one object to another: once both ends are attached, the line follows when the objects move (for flowcharts).
上方可以選直線或直角；拖曳選取的連接線兩端可以改連到別的物件，放在空白處就是自由的端點。	Choose straight or elbow above; drag either end of a selected connector onto another object to reattach it, or onto empty space for a free end.
在線條上按住往外拖讓那裡變粗、往內拖變細（同 Illustrator 的寬度工具）；菱形是控制點，Alt＋點刪掉。	Press on a line and drag outward to thicken it there, inward to thin it (like Illustrator's Width tool); diamonds are width points, Alt+click removes one.
上方可以一次套用寬度樣式：尾端變尖、兩端尖、中間粗、毛筆…；沒有選取時給之後畫的線。	Apply a width style in one go above: taper end, taper both, thick middle, brush…; with nothing selected it applies to lines you draw next.
寬度樣式	Width Style
套到選取的線條：均勻、尾端變尖、起點變尖、兩端尖、中間粗、中間細、毛筆、水滴。	Applies to the selected lines: uniform, taper end, taper start, taper both, thick middle, thin middle, brush, teardrop.
填色方式選「圖樣」時的花樣：條紋、圓點、棋盤、格線、斜格、磚牆、波浪、菱形，或紋理筆的材質。	The pattern used when the fill type is "Pattern": stripes, dots, checkerboard, grid, crosshatch, bricks, waves, diamonds, or a Texture-brush material.
填色是底色、第二色是花樣的顏色；圖形移動時圖樣跟著。	The fill is the background and the second color is the pattern color; the pattern moves with the shape.
圖樣大小	Pattern Size
一格花樣的大小（照片像素）。	Size of one pattern tile (photo pixels).
圖樣角度	Pattern Angle
花樣轉幾度。	Rotation of the pattern in degrees.
尺寸線方向	Dimension Direction
平行：沿兩點量；水平：只量左右距離；垂直：只量上下距離。	Aligned: measures along the two points; Horizontal: only the left-right distance; Vertical: only the up-down distance.
標籤的單位。不是像素時，填「每單位像素」換算（預設 96 dpi：1 公分 ＝ 37.8 像素）。	The label's unit. For units other than pixels, set "Pixels per unit" for the conversion (default 96 dpi: 1 cm = 37.8 px).
小數位數	Decimal Places
標籤的數字顯示到小數第幾位。	How many decimal places the label shows.
連接線樣式	Connector Style
直線：兩個物件中心的連線（切在物件邊上）；直角：水平、垂直轉彎。	Straight: the line between the two objects' centers (cut at their edges); Elbow: turns horizontally and vertically.
均勻	Uniform
尾端變尖	Taper End
起點變尖	Taper Start
兩端尖	Taper Both
中間粗	Thick Middle
中間細	Thin Middle
向量手繪	Vector Freehand
筆壓：{0}	Pen pressure: {0}
軟（輕輕畫就很濃）	Soft (light strokes are already dark)
硬（要用力才濃）	Firm (press hard for dark strokes)
標準	Normal
筆壓	Pressure
硬	Firm
軟	Soft
左右	Left-right
上下	Top-bottom
四向	Four-way
文件色票	Document Swatches
（在左側色彩面板按「＋」加入）	(add them with "+" in the color panel on the left)
全部恢復預設	Restore All Defaults
再製	Duplicate
寬度樣式（套到選取的線，沒選時給之後畫的線）	Width style (applies to the selected line, or to lines you draw next)
選取的物件	Selected objects
節點（節點工具點選節點後可用）	Nodes (available after selecting nodes with the Node tool)
